title: Manager I, Engineering - Security Libraries
description: <p>The Security Libraries team owns the customer-side integrations behind Datadog’s run-time security products — <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/app-and-api-protection/">App & API Protection</a>, <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/workload-protection/">Workload Protection</a>, and <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/code-security/">Code Security</a> — shipping and maintaining security capabilities across seven open-source language libraries (<a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-dotnet">.NET</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-java">Java</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go">Go</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js">Node.js</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-py">Python</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-rb">Ruby</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-php">PHP</a>) and a set of HTTP proxy integrations (Envoy, NGINX, and HAProxy), running inside thousands of production clusters worldwide.</p> <p>Recent work spans exploit prevention (RASP), WAF detections, API Security, code security (IAST and SCA), and AI-assisted onboarding. As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead part of this polyglot team, setting the technical bar and team culture while driving the pace at which new detections and AI-assisted capabilities reach customers. judgment</li> <li>A track record developing people: coaching, direct feedback, and helping engineers, both senior and struggling, grow</li> <li>Strong cross-team communication, comfortable driving alignment across many stakeholders</li> <li>Experience building libraries, SDKs, developer tooling, or systems/run-time software</li> <li>Pragmatic product-engineering experience — you’ve worked with Product Managers and weighed technical trade-offs against customer impact</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An application security background (WAF, RASP, IAST/SCA) or adjacent title: Process Engineer (m/f/d)

title: Schülerpraktikant (m/w/d)
description: Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Du möchtest im Rahmen Deines Schulpraktikums oder freiwilligen Praktikums unsere Unternehmenswelt kennenlernen? Du erarbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte und Aufgaben. Du begleitest unsere Auszubildenden und dual Studierenden bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit. Unser Bewerbungsstatus für die kommenden Monate auf einen Blick: Grün: Du hast Glück! In diesen Monaten sind noch Plätze frei – nutze Deine Chance und bewirb Dich schnell. Gelb: Es wird eng! title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle gestaltest du CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit. Du verbindest strategisches Denken, analytische Tiefe und operative Umsetzung: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in intelligente Segmente und automatisierte Journeys, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Du entwickelst dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kampagnen und nutzt Daten, um die Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji: Aufbau einer skalierbaren CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion im B2C-Bereich sowie Übernahme der strategischen und operativen Verantwortung . Verantwortung für den vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle: von Hypothese und Konzeption über Segmentierung, A/B-Tests und Kohorten bis zum Aufbau, zur Analyse und zur Iteration automatisierter Flows. Entwicklung dynamischer Segmente und Journeys, die unterschiedliche Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen. Eigenständige Analyse von Daten, Identifikation relevanter Hebel und Priorisierung von Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und Analytics, um Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für relevante CRM-Maßnahmen zu nutzen. Verständnis der Zusammenhänge zwischen CRM-Systemen, Datenquellen und technischen Abläufen sowie Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft. Mitgestaltung der CRM-Systemlandschaft sowie sichere Anwendung von Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbaren Marketing-Automation-Plattformen als Core User. Hands-on-Umsetzung von Maßnahmen – von der Konzeption und dem Flow-Aufbau bis zur Auswertung und Optimierung. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Praktische Erfahrung mit dem vollständigen Kampagnen-Lifecycle – von Hypothese und Konzeption über komplexe Segmentierung, Kohorten und Flow-Aufbau bis zu Analyse und Iteration. Starke analytische Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Daten-Affinität sowie Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Kohortenanalysen oder vergleichbaren Experimenten. Erfahrung mit komplexen Segmenten und automatisierten Journeys in einem datengetriebenen CRM- oder Lifecycle-Umfeld. Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM- beziehungsweise Marketing-Automation-Plattform. Technisches Grundverständnis für die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe von CRM-Systemen, Marketing-Automation-Plattformen und relevanten Datenquellen. Strategische und operative Arbeitsweise: Du identifizierst Hebel, setzt Prioritäten und setzt Maßnahmen selbstständig um. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Stage - Juriste IP/IT
description: Chez Brevo, nous ne nous contentons pas de construire un CRM. Grâce à notre technologie, nous aidons des millions d'organisations à créer des relations durables avec leurs clients. Des e-mails aux SMS, en passant par WhatsApp, le Chat et le Marketing Automation, nos outils sont intuitifs, puissants et conçus pour évoluer avec chaque ambition. En tant qu'entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous sommes fiers de grandir avec un objectif, engagés envers des standards élevés d'impact social et environnemental, et pas seulement de performance. Aujourd'hui, plus de 500 000 entreprises dans 180 pays — des ONG comme Amnesty International à des marques mondiales comme Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton et Michelin — font confiance à Brevo pour engager leurs audiences, réduire la complexité et obtenir des résultats. title: Growth Marketing - Germany 🇩🇪
description: Our Mission ⚖️ At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform. Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard. Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities. Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting. And we're just getting started. We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle. Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive. The team you're joining A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins. The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀) A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both) Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections Your missions Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears. Internationalization : design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France). Inbound Lead Gen : team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible. Outbound Lead Gen : pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking). Nurturing : build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention. Field Marketing & Product Growth : back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches. The profile we're looking for You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). Hard skills AI is your copilot : this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick. Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…). A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys. A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick. A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins. Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus). Soft skills Fluency in English is required to communicate with the team. Fluency in German, it's a plus. Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide. Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark. A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans. Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry. Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership. Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow. Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume. (The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.) Ladies, go ahead and apply! title: Business Development Representative - Customers
description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Mission principale En tant que Business Development Representatives (BDR) dédié.e à notre parc clients avocats, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille. L’objectif sera d’ identifier des nouvelles opportunités de business exclusivement sur nos produits transverses. Vous serez un partenaire de premier choix pour aider les Account Managers à faire grandir la valeur des contrats sur nos nouveaux produits. Responsabilité Identification des opportunités cross-sell : Analyser le portefeuille de clients existants pour détecter des opportunités de vente des produits annexes. Qualification des clients actuels : Recueillir des informations stratégiques sur les clients pour mieux comprendre leurs enjeux, et qualifier leurs besoins en nouveaux produits ou services. Engagement des décideurs clés : Collaborer étroitement avec les clients existants, notamment les décideurs, pour organiser des rendez-vous et des démonstrations avec les Account Managers. Veille stratégique sur le portefeuille client : Assurer une bonne compréhension des informations clés sur le marché, les clients existants, les tendances sectorielles et les opportunités potentielles. title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs. Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme How we get work done 🚀 Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme. Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation. Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code. Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement. Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes. Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités How our work creates impact 🎯 Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence Compétences 💼 Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes. Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions. Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS. IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS. Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue. Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders. Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage. Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral Qualités 🌟 Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent. Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes. Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants. Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client. Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design Expérience 📇 Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle , pas seulement contribué à l'un Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des intégrations design to code Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative , dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent) Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design. Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de delivery. Ce que nous offrons 🎊 Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence. Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone). Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc. Les étapes du process 🎢 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc. Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse ! title: Product Engineer, Shop
description: ABOUT INSIFY We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild. Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance. About the role You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers. The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people. Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows. As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together. You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth. What you'll be doing Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others What you'll need 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you. Nice to have Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too Our stack TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before. We offer Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000. Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves. Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days. Pension. We contribute 6% for you. Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it. Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them. A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks. Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Alliances - Manager (F/H)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a <strong>Human First</strong> philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore. </p> <p>VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p> <p>For more information, please visit <a href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="d4b7d1c3-8ad6-4b6d-ab45-d3cb5a3aebe1">www.vml.com </a>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&e=" data-outlook-id="a3ef68bf-16fb-4ebc-9ca9-406007d6cefc">LinkedIn</a> #WeAreVML.</p></div><p>Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.</p> <p><strong>Missions</strong></p> <p>En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de VML Consulting avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :</p> <ul> <li>Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos <em>capabilities </em>auprès de clients et prospects,</li> <li>Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de VML Consulting et du réseau WPP</li> </ul> <p>Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.</p> <p><em>Dimension Business :</em></p> <ul> <li>Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de VML Consulting avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,</li> <li>Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,</li> <li>Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,</li> <li>Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,</li> <li>Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,</li> <li>Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de VML Consulting dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),</li> <li>Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne VML Consulting comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,</li> <li>Contribue au thought leadership de VML Consulting sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,</li> <li>Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,</li> <li>Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.</li> </ul> <p><em>Dimension Enablement & Delivery :</em></p> <ul> <li>Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,</li> <li>Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p>Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.</p> <p>Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.</p> <p>Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.</p> <p>Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de VML Consulting.</p> <p>Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.</p> <p>Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.</p> <p>La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.</p> <p><strong>Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</strong></p> <p><strong>Ce que nous <li>Soirées et team building réguliers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Intégrer VML Consulting, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. Nous rejoindre, c’est participer à une aventure collective au service de l’épanouissement personnel.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
description: 🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB. Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren. Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung. Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag. Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich. 💡 DEINE MISSION Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist. Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält. 🚀 DEIN ALLTAG Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation. Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen. Zwischen Pflege, Medizincontrolling und System übersetzen: Anforderungen aus Kodierrichtlinien und Prüfverfahren machst du für Pflegeteams greifbar, und Pflegealltag für das Medizincontrolling. Wirkung sichtbar machen: Gemeinsam mit den Kliniken legst du fest, woran sich Dokumentationsqualität messen lässt, und unterstützt bei ROI-Workshops mit Geschäftsführung und Medizincontrolling. Sauber einordnen: Läuft etwas nicht wie erwartet, findest du heraus, ob es an der KIS-Konfiguration, am Prozess auf Station oder am Produkt liegt. Deine Einschätzung geht klar an Customer Success, Support und Product, und du bringst die Sicht des Medizincontrollings in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Krankenhaus-Produkts ein. Kliniken begleiten: Remote und bei Bedarf vor Ort begleitest du Einführungen über den Go-live hinaus, eng abgestimmt mit dem zuständigen Customer Success Manager. Wissen aufbauen, das skaliert: Gemeinsam mit dem Team entwickelst du Playbooks, Checklisten und interne Enablements für den Krankenhausbereich, etwa zu DRG-Grundlagen und MD-Prüfungen für unsere Kolleg:innen. 🤝 DEIN PROFIL Du hast mindestens eine Weiterbildung zur Medizinischen Kodierfachkraft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und Praxis im Medizincontrolling eines Krankenhauses. Erfahrung als Medizincontroller:in ist ein großes Plus. Du bist sicher im aG-DRG-System, in ICD-10-GM, OPS und den Deutschen Kodierrichtlinien und kennst die Abläufe rund um MD-Prüfungen und die Prüfverfahrensvereinbarung aus eigener Fallbearbeitung. Idealerweise bringst du einen pflegerischen Grundberuf mit, etwa in der Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege, und weißt, wie Dokumentation auf Station wirklich entsteht. Du hast mit einem KIS gearbeitet, am liebsten mit ORBIS von Dedalus. Pflegerische Assessments und Leistungserfassung wie ePA-AC oder LEP sind dir vertraut oder du arbeitest dich schnell ein. Systeme sind für dich Werkzeug, kein Hindernis. Du denkst in Abhängigkeiten und Ursachen und bleibst dran, bis du verstehst, warum etwas so ist. Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, einer Pflegedirektion genauso wie einer Pflegekraft im Spätdienst oder der Geschäftsführung einer Klinik. Du arbeitest gern beratend und strukturiert. Du gibst klare Empfehlungen und vertrittst sie auch. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Auf Englisch solltest du dich sicher verständigen können, weil ein Teil der internen Zusammenarbeit auf Englisch läuft. Du bist gern bei unseren Kunden. Termine vor Ort gehören regelmäßig dazu, der Großteil deiner Arbeit läuft remote. 🌱 GEMEINSAM WACHSEN – DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI voize Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Startup. Du übernimmst neue Themen, wächst schnell und bewirkst etwas, das Pflegekräften mehr Zeit für die Menschen gibt. Du gestaltest mit: Unser Krankenhausbereich wächst gerade, und du prägst, wie wir Kliniken fachlich begleiten. Wir leben eine offene, kollaborative Kultur mit regelmäßigen Team-Events, ob du aus unserem Berliner Office arbeitest oder remote aus Deutschland. Mit Stock Options wirst du Teil unseres Erfolgs. 30 Urlaubstage plus dein Geburtstag frei, Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club, regelmäßige Company-Offsites sowie Zugang zu Lernplattformen wie Blinkist und Audible. Du entscheidest, wann du am besten arbeitest: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein gutes Hybrid-Setup. ✨ LUST AUF EIN GESPRÄCH? JETZT BEWERBEN. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen, ganz gleich, wer du bist und welchen Hintergrund du mitbringst. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d)
description: Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für den Bereich IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns bei der Planung und Umsetzung der IT-Infrastruktur unterstützen. Wir suchen Leute, die anpacken und etwas aufbauen wollen. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem Unternehmen mit echtem Impact die IT mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Gehalt: 4.700 Euro pro Monat (brutto) Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden. Was wir dir bieten: Langfristige Perspektive: Wir stellen ein, um langfristig zusammenzuarbeiten – das Ziel ist immer eine unbefristete Anstellung. description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. Job Description 🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. Responsibilities: Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role) Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments. Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against. Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data. Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design. Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements. Scale legal as a business enabler Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset. Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation. Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling. Nice-to-haves 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems. 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience. 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed. If you meet most but not all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure. Proactively fix security flaws by writing patches, submitting Pull Requests (PRs), or collaborating directly with product teams to guide remediation. Audit and harden our cloud infrastructure (GCP, Kubernetes clusters, and networking configurations) against external and internal threats. Automate security tooling into our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanners) to catch CVEs before code reaches production. Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks. Lead incident response efforts and establish continuous monitoring, detection, and mitigation strategies. Own our public security posture as an open-source project: vulnerability disclosure process, CVE handling, security advisories, and the trust model of our plugin ecosystem. Our Tech Stack Security & Vulnerability Tools : Trivy, GitHub Security / Dependabot, Elastic Security Infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Cloud : GCP Programming language : Java, Typescript, Javascript Datastore : PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch Queuing : Redis, Kafka, AMQP Monitoring & Logs : ELK, Prometheus, Grafana Deployment & Repository : GitHub Actions, ArgoCD What we are looking for 5+ years of experience in Security Engineering, Product Security, DevSecOps, or a combined Offensive/Defensive role. Strong hands-on penetration testing background , with proven ability to discover application, API, and network-level vulnerabilities. A builder/fixer mindset : You don't just export scanner PDFs; you can read code, understand exploits, write fixes, or provide clear remediation steps to engineers. Deep familiarity with cloud security (AWS or GCP) and containerized environments ( Kubernetes , Docker). Experience with dependency and supply-chain security (CVE management, open-source licensing, SCA tools). Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment. Adaptability to a fast-paced open-source startup environment where pragmatism and execution speed matter. Perks & Benefits Work from anywhere : We’re a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you’ll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery. Health coverage : From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered. Home office setup on us : We’ll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably. Our Hiring Process We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed. Intro call with the hiring manager (30 min) Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous homework focusing on threat assessment and remediation) Team chat with one of your future colleagues (30 min) Final discussion with one of our co-founders (30 min) Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Group Accountant ( M/F)
description: <h1>The role</h1> <p>Horizon Trading Solutions (HTS) is hiring a Senior Group Accountant( F/M) to bring accounting processes in-house, strengthen compliance with international accounting standards and external reporting requirements, and implement new tools (systems of record / automation). We currently work with external accountants; you will lead the operational transition and build the processes, controls and systems that give HTS reliable financial information.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role with scope to shape how accounting works at HTS. You will combine day-to-day accounting ownership with ERP implementation and practical uses of AI. Full professional fluency in English is essential, as you will interact confidently with international stakeholders, global business partners, and external advisors across jurisdictions.</p> <h1>Missions</h1> <h2>Accounting Operations</h2> <ul> <li>Take ownership of the accounting function’s internalization: map all activities currently handled by external accountants and execute a phased handover covering records, opening balances, responsibilities, controls and deadlines.</li> <li>Deliver a significant improvement in the quality, accuracy and consistency of the accounting records, ensuring that transactions are properly supported, classified and reflected in the general ledger.</li> <li>Strengthen monthly, quarterly and annual closing schedules, documented journal entries, analytical reviews and clear explanations of material movements and variances.</li> <li>Establish rigorous balance-sheet reconciliations for all significant accounts, with documented support, timely investigation of discrepancies and disciplined clearance of aged or outstanding items.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of the accounts and underlying business flows, enabling reliable financial analysis, early identification of accounting issues and clear communication of financial performance to management.</li> <li>Improve accounting policies, documentation and internal controls in line with applicable accounting standards and external reporting requirements; coordinate statutory accounts, tax filings and audit requests with external advisors while retaining clear internal ownership.</li> </ul> <h2>ERP implementation</h2> <ul> <li>Lead a significant 12-month ERP implementation project that must be delivered from requirements definition through testing, data migration, go-live and stabilization, working closely with internal teams and implementation partners.</li> <li>Define the chart of accounts, analytical dimensions, accounting rules and approval workflows; connect purchasing, billing and banking processes to the ledger.</li> <li>Document workflows, train users and support adoption; prioritise improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen controls and shorten the close.</li> </ul> <h2>Artificial Intelligence (AI)</h2> <ul> <li>Identify, assess and pilot high-value AI applications across accounting, including invoice and document extraction, reconciliation support, anomaly detection, close assistance, cash-flow analysis and first drafts of variance commentary.</li> <li>Build controlled AI workflows using approved tools that protect confidential data; title: Senior Cyber Underwriter, London
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About us</span></h4> <p>Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.   </p> <p>Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.</p></div><h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About the role</span></h4> <p>The Senior Cyber Underwriter owns profitable growth across an assigned broker portfolio, combining disciplined underwriting with active relationship development. This role operates independently within delegated authority while partnering closely with Sales and Product to execute territory strategies and deliver production and profit targets. </p> <p>The role underwrites Coalition’s Cyber and Technology PI solutions and serves as a trusted resource to brokers and customers. This includes assessing and pricing risk, developing market opportunities, and educating partners on practical ways to strengthen cyber protection. The position is remote within the UK, with regular travel for broker, client, and internal engagements.</p> <p><strong><em>This is a hybrid opportunity with the expectation that this person will be able to work out of the London office (2-3 days a week) for business purposes and broker engagement.</em></strong></p> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Responsibilities</span></h4> <ul> <li>Underwrite Cyber and Technology PI risks within delegated authority and Coalition guidelines.</li> <li>Build and manage strategic broker relationships while generating, qualifying, and progressing new business opportunities.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Product to execute territory strategies and achieve production and profitability targets.</li> <li>Apply knowledge of the UK cyber insurance market to identify opportunities and capture profitable market share.</li> <li>Educate brokers and customers on cyber exposures, coverage solutions, and risk improvement.</li> <li>Manage broker relationships, placement timelines, policy workflows, and stakeholder commitments with consistent execution.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Skills and Qualifications</span></h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of multiline underwriting experience focused on Cyber, Technology PI, or related security risks</li> <li>Strong cyber risk analysis, underwriting, coverage, compliance, product, and pricing capabilities.</li> <li>Ability to manage a broker pipeline, territory, and portfolio while meeting monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building agency relationships and managing high-volume work within tight timeframes.</li> <li>Strong sales, communication, negotiation, marketing, and influencing skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently within delegated authority and collaborate effectively with Sales and Product.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Bonus Points </span></h4> <ul> <li>ACII or another relevant professional insurance designation.</li> <li>Experience underwriting technology-sector risks and Technology PI solutions.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of UK cyber market trends, competitive dynamics, and broker networks.</li> <li>Experience educating brokers or customers on cyber risk prevention and risk improvement.</li> <li>Track record of identifying creative opportunities to grow profitable market share.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Perks</span></h4> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li>100% medical coverage, including outpatient care</li> <li>Life insurance </li> <li>25+ paid holidays</li> <li>Annual home office stipend</li> <li>7% employer pension contribution</li> <li>Mental and physical health wellness programs like Headspace, Wellhub</li> <li>Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Why Coalition? </span></h4> <p>Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.</p> <p>We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.</p> <p><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://www.coalitioninc.com/newsroom" target="_blank">Visit our Newsroom > </a></p> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Privacy Notice</span></h4> <p>Coalition is committed to protecting your privacy and handling your personal information responsibly. title: Major Account Executive, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About us</span></h4> <p>Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.   </p> <p>Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.</p></div><h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">About the role</span></h4> <div> <p>We're looking for a Major Account Executive to own and grow a book of strategic enterprise accounts. This is a role for someone who can run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles into security-conscious buying committees (CISO, CIO, procurement, legal, and often the board) and close 3-year enterprise commitments in a competitive, incumbent-heavy market, while navigating channel partners (e.g. VARs and Distributors). </p> <p>You'll be selling into organizations where a security failure is existential, where the buying process is genuinely adversarial by design, and where trust is earned through technical credibility and long-term relationships, not charisma. If you've sold into security teams before, you know this isn't a "build rapport and close" motion — it's proving you understand the threat model as well as the buyer does.</p> </div> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Responsibilities</span></h4> <ul> <li>Own and grow a book of major/strategic accounts, running the full cycle from qualification through multi-year contract negotiation and close</li> <li>Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees — security, IT, legal, procurement, and executive sponsors — building consensus across functions with genuinely competing priorities</li> <li>Partner with technical presales Solutions Architects to run live technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts that hold up under real scrutiny from technical buyers</li> <li>Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, with a strong bias toward multi-year (3-year) terms</li> <li>Build and defend a business case that speaks fluently to both risk reduction (CISO language) and ROI (CFO language) — you need both, not one</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene on long-cycle (6–9 month), high-ACV deals</li> <li>Prioritize Customer Success for account health, since renewal risk on an account this size is a shared problem, not a handoff</li> </ul> <h4><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Skills and Qualifications</span></h4> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of closing experience in enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS</strong></li> <li>Demonstrated ability to close deals upwards of $1M ARR or more and 6+ month sales cycles</li> <li>Track record of navigating security-specific procurement: vendor risk assessments, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 diligence, security questionnaires, and legal review cycles that are more adversarial than typical SaaS title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst Pricing (all genders)
description: <h2>The role</h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Marketing Data Analyst</strong> on our <strong>Pricing Analytics</strong> team within the Global <strong>Marketing Analytics</strong> organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in driving data-informed pricing and discount decisions at HelloFresh. Based in our Berlin Headquarters, you'll help build best-in-class analytics to support price and discount strategy across HelloFresh's brands — turning data into strategic recommendations, challenging the status quo, and directly shaping how our global brands price, grow, and operate.</p> <p>Reporting to the Associate Director of Pricing Analytics, you'll partner closely with the commercial Pricing & Discount Strategy team and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, ML&AI, and Finance. You'll bring the toolkit of a data scientist — experimentation, causal inference, and modeling — and the judgment to turn it into decisions. As our scope expands, there's room to grow into broader <strong>Market Insights</strong> work supporting senior leadership across our 15+ markets.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own price and discount experiments end to end</strong> — frame the hypothesis, design the test, size it, launch it through our always-on testing program, and deliver the readout.</li> <li><strong>Model how customers respond to price and promotions</strong> — price elasticity, geo-segmented pricing, discount and promo effects, and ML-assisted discount recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Apply causal inference</strong> — incrementality and quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, matching) — to measure true impact where a clean A/B test isn't possible.</li> <li><strong>Ship analysis as data products</strong> — production pipelines and self-serve apps (Databricks, SQL, Python, Streamlit) that stakeholders use directly, not one-off notebooks.</li> <li><strong>Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets</strong> that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.</li> <li><strong>Communicate complex technical findings</strong> as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing</strong> to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate with and mentor analysts</strong> within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.</li> <li><strong>As scope grows</strong>, measure, benchmark, and monitor brand and market performance and help inform Marketing budgets — contributing to the Market Insights agenda alongside senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>A <strong>motivated, collaborative mindset</strong> with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.</li> <li><strong>4+ years of experience</strong> in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.</li> <li><strong>Strong SQL and Python</strong> (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.</li> <li>A foundation in <strong>experimental design and A/B testing</strong>, including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.</li> <li>Working knowledge of <strong>causal inference and econometrics</strong> — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.</li> <li>Solid <strong>applied statistics</strong>, and familiarity with common <strong>machine-learning</strong> methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.</li> <li>A strong understanding of <strong>Marketing and Growth metrics</strong> and how they connect to overall business performance.</li> <li>Comfort in a <strong>modern data stack</strong> (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool (<strong>Tableau</strong>, Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).</li> <li>A <strong>results-oriented, structured approach</strong>, able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.</li> <li>Proven <strong>project ownership and stakeholder management</strong>, especially in senior or cross-functional settings.</li> <li><strong>Excellent communication skills in English</strong>, with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to have:</p> <ul> <li>Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.</li> <li>Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.</li> <li>Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.</li> <li>GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh-subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access, wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <h2>Are you up for the challenge?</h2> <p>Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</p> <p>#JD1002</p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Engineer, Growth Mega Alliance (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>The Growth Mega Alliance (GMA) builds the platforms that power how HelloFresh acquires, converts, and retains customers across 18 markets and multiple brands, across five pillars: AdTech, Conversions, Payments, Communications, and Customer Value Optimization (CVO).</p> <p>As Principal Engineer, you are the technical visionary for these platforms. You define architectural direction across all five pillars, lead the most consequential cross-cutting initiatives, and raise the technical bar for the entire organization. This is a hands-on leadership role - you code, review, and design alongside the senior and staff engineers who look to you as the technical lead.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>GenAI & Agentic Engineering Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own GMA's GenAI strategy: identify the highest-leverage opportunities across all five pillars where AI/ML unlocks step-change outcomes, for both engineering productivity and customer-facing capabilities.</li> <li>Establish agentic development workflows — where specs drive AI-assisted code generation — and scale them from early adopters to standard practice. Build the guardrails and reference architectures that enable squads to work AI-natively.</li> <li>Develop and articulate a clear point of view on how engineering teams need to evolve in skills, process, and culture to realize the gains that agentic tools make possible.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Growth Platform Architecture</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the long-term technical architecture across GMA's five pillars: real-time personalization, experimentation at scale, AI/ML-driven automation, and cross-pillar data integrity.</li> <li>Lead the most complex architectural decisions (shared identity schemas, experiment assignment, AdTech-to-Conversions signal loops, payment authorization flows) and drive migrations with large impact.</li> <li>Ensure GMA platforms integrate cleanly with internal infrastructure and meet reliability, latency, and observability requirements at a global scale. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Experimentation & Personalization</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define GMA's experimentation strategy and execution framework to optimize experimentation-based decision-making at scale.</li> <li>Own the data path from customer event to business decision: instrumentation standards, identity resolution, attribution windows, and signal quality.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Technical Strategy & Cross-Alliance Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define GMA's multi-year technical vision and communicate it with the precision engineers need and the clarity executives can act on. Represent GMA in company-wide programs.</li> <li>Partner with Intelligent Platforms, Consumer, and Operations Mega Alliances to drive shared architectural standards and prevent fragmentation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Mentorship & Engineering Culture</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Coach and grow Staff and Senior Engineers across all five pillars. Foster engineering excellence through rigorous design review, strong observability practice, and honest post-incident learning.</li> <li>Champion AI-native development workflows, TDD, DDD, and DevSecOps. Set the written communication standard through your design docs and architectural decision records.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <h3><strong>GenAI & Agentic Engineering</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Practical, hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) in production or near-production environments — not just experimentation.</li> <li>Experience integrating GenAI into customer-facing products or internal business processes at scale, with a clear point of view on the team and cultural changes required to realize the productivity gains.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Growth Domain Expertise</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Deep familiarity with at least two of: AdTech / paid media infrastructure, funnel optimization, payment orchestration, CRM and lifecycle communications, or pricing and incentive optimization.</li> <li>Fluent in growth domain constraints: PSP behavior, consent and privacy requirements across markets, deliverability limits, attribution windows, and incrementality measurement. Experience in a multi-market subscription or e-commerce business preferred.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Technical Depth</strong></h3> <ul> <li>~10+ years in software engineering, with ~5+ years at principal level in a high-growth, cloud-native environment.</li> <li>Expert in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven patterns (Kafka). Deep AWS experience. Strong proficiency in Go, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.</li> <li>Track record of designing and operating large-scale, multi-region systems. Comfortable doing hands-on architectural reviews and solving critical bottlenecks directly.</li> <li>Working knowledge of experimentation design and analysis; able to work directly with data (SQL, BI tooling) and trace the full signal chain from instrumentation to business metric.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Ways of Working</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional written communication — your documents make complexity smaller, not larger.</li> <li>Able to influence without authority; direct, low-ego, and comfortable disagreeing with senior stakeholders while keeping the relationship intact.</li> <li>Fluent English. German is a bonus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p><strong>3 months — </strong>You have mapped GMA's critical architectural dependencies and GenAI opportunities, conducted design reviews across multiple pillars, and established a point of view on the highest-leverage technical bets for the year.</p> <p><strong>6 months — </strong>Your architectural direction is reflected in roadmaps. GMA's first AI-native workflows are in production. At least one cross-pillar initiative is running under your technical ownership with clear instrumentation.</p> <p><strong>12 months — </strong>GMA's platforms are measurably more scalable, observable, and AI-capable. Engineering standards are set and followed. You are the person leaders across HelloTech bring their hardest growth-engineering problems to.</p> <h2><strong>Why Work With Us</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Make an Impact: </strong>GMA's platforms touch every customer HelloFresh acquires and every euro it collects. Your decisions move top-line numbers at a company that has changed the way millions of people eat.</li> <li><strong>Real Scope: </strong>You own technical direction, make consequential architectural calls, and ship things that matter — at a scale that makes the problems genuinely hard.</li> <li><strong>AI at the Frontier: </strong>You will have the mandate, resources, and organizational support to lead AI-native engineering transformation — not advocate for it from the sidelines.</li> <li><strong>Direct Access: </strong>You work daily with engineering, product, and business leadership, with the visibility and accountability that implies.</li> <li><strong>Learn & Grow: </strong>Annual learning budget, HelloFresh Academy, and internal mobility across a large, technically ambitious engineering organization.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
