title: QA Director
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a QA Director to join our Stumble Guys team in our Barcelona or Dundee hubs, working in a hybrid mode 3 days from the hub.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. </p> <p>Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do </strong></p> <p>You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA & Deployment. </p> <p>You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Day to day responsibilities may include:</p> <ul> <li>Lead an ambitious Mobile and Console QA & Deployment Program involving multiple disciplines, including Functionality QA, Dev QA, Live-Ops QA, Build Distribution and Submissions across all platforms</li> <li>Manage and provide leadership, technical expertise and career development for multiple QA & Deployment Project Owners; support the skillset growth across the QA & Deployment crafts, leading to higher value individual contributors and managers</li> <li>Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvements</li> <li>Manage day-to-day relationships with external QA vendors, aligning priorities, capacity and deliverables with project needs; assess vendor performance against agreed quality and delivery targets and drive improvement actions</li> <li>Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts and AI implementation into QA pipelines. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders, partners, and executives</li> <li>Establish and maintain strong communication with cross-functional teams across all disciplines for both internal and external development, QA and Localization partners</li> <li>Work with the Deployment Project Managers and Dev QA teams to create efficient plans, assignments, and schedules for associated quality functions</li> <li>Continually improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the QA & Deployment effort by assessing current practices and incorporating new strategies</li> <li>Be the internal advocate and spokesperson for all things QA & Deployment. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders</li> <li>Hold fellow leaders accountable for including quality as an essential factor in product development</li> <li>Lead regular performance assessments of QA & Deployment Project Owners and their teams, using clear objectives, quality metrics and stakeholder feedback to guide coaching, development and performance improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>10 + years as a quality assurance professional</li> <li>6 + years management experience in leading a team through a full game cycle</li> <li>Excellent written/verbal communication in English</li> <li>Experience in building and managing a QA organization that is responsible for end-to-end validation for a critical system or application</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing external QA vendors, including setting delivery expectations, assessing performance and driving service improvements, alongside a strong understanding of Dev QA and external testing strategies.</li> <li>Experience working with remote teams and with a cross functional team that is distributed around the globe</li> <li>Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management, working to develop and maintain strong, effective relationships across the organization</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure of hard deadlines</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing bug defect solutions & creating test plans</li> <li>Strong understanding of software development (SDLC) practices & nomenclature, quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies</li> <li>Flexible and dynamic – quickly adapt to changing needs of the business</li> <li>Good understanding of the current and evolving landscape of AI-powered testing tools, and experience driving the transition from manual testing approaches to AI-native.</li> <li>Business awareness - the ability to view situations from a business perspective</li> <li>Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA</li> <li>Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with Console and PC deployment & compliance.</li> <li>Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>. </p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p>Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.</p> <p><strong>Missions</strong></p> <p>En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.</p> <p>Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer title: Director of Field Operations (f/m/d)
description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface. Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics. You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice. Your Day to Day Running Operations (≈ 40%) Own end-to-end delivery of installations, on-site service, and scheduled maintenance across Europe and the US — on time, on budget, and at a quality level appropriate to assets worth more than €1M each. Empower and enable Regional Leaders and Project Managers to flawlessly orchestrate complex site deliveries involving customers, MRI suppliers, and automation partners. Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk. Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed. Building the Operating System (≈ 35%) Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors. Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team. Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it. Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure. Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%) Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail. Design the organisation ahead of the growth curve: hire, structure, and re-structure as we add verticals and geographies, and find the right mix of own team, partner networks, and variable capacity models to absorb fluctuating demand. Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to. Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly. How You Fit In You report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead Field Operations through two regional team leads, with Field Engineers delivering installation, on-site service, and maintenance work and Project Managers coordinating customers, partners, and internal teams. The team will keep growing as we roll out new geographies and products. You work closely with Technical Customer Support, Operational Excellence, Supply Chain, Hardware, Product, and Business Development, and you own our operational relationship with our equipment and automation partners. You are part of the wider operations leadership team and contribute to decisions well beyond your own function. Your Experiences and Skills 10+ years in field or service operations. You have led installation, on-site service, and maintenance operations for complex technical products. Hardware plus service business models. You understand a business where the machine is only half the promise and installation, uptime, and maintenance are the other half. Experience at operational scale. You have worked inside an organisation that had already solved this properly — mature SOPs, field service tooling, quality processes, clear team structures — and you know what “good” actually looks like, not just in theory. Multi-region leadership. You have built and led geographically distributed teams and developed team leads into strong operational leaders. Hands-on and strategic. You can design the operating model and the roadmap, and you will also get on a plane and stand on a site on short notice when the situation calls for it. Continuous improvement as a reflex. You see every error as an opportunity and an obligation to be better next time, and you have the methods to back that up. Technical fluency. You can engage credibly on site planning, requirement specifications, and installation and commissioning detail, and hold your own with engineers, suppliers, and customers’ technical teams. Drive and proactiveness. You move before being asked, chase ambiguity down rather than escalating it up, and you are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. Senior communicator. You build trust with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, and you can deliver difficult messages without damaging the relationship. Practicalities. Willingness to travel to European and US sites, and an EU Class B driver’s licence. Fluent in English; additional languages (German, Spanish, Italian, French) are a plus. What Makes You Stand Out Experience in a venture-capital-backed, private-equity-backed or similarly execution-driven environment, where operational discipline, cost, and delivery commitments were tracked seriously. You have taken a field operations function through a step change in scale — doubling geographies, product lines, or installed base — and can describe what broke and what you did about it. Formal continuous improvement or quality credentials (Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent) that you have actually applied to a service organisation. Hands-on experience implementing field service management or service data tooling, including getting a team to adopt it. Experience in a high-growth deep-tech or capital-equipment company, where the product was still changing underneath the operation. You are obsessed with customer experience and can point to the operational choices you made to protect it. What We Offer International Environment: Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges. Comprehensive Benefits: Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success. Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany. Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth. Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club, Wellhub or Wellpass. Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees. Deutschland Ticket: Full coverage of public transportation. Work-Life Integration: Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you. WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us! 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge. Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments. Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year. Make a Difference: Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you. Your Team: You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/ At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway! Compensation: €120K – €135K • €120K – €180K Equity • Compensation Range €120K – €135K • €120K – €180K Equity Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

High agency, low ego. There's unsexy work and you'll do it without flinching. You want to work hard and be part of something ambitious. You speak German at a native level and are fluent in English. title: Principal Security Engineer
description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. About the Role You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner. You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model. Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams. What You'll Do Risk & Governance Map Vibe's risk model across every major system. Set the security roadmap with clear priorities. Security Engineering Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set. Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one. Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers. Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you. Detection & Response Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure. Own security incident response from detection through resolution. Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own. Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program. Trust & Compliance Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification. Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements. Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you. Security Culture Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day. Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar. What You Need Built a security function as a company's first security hire. Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience. Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA. Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day. Nice to Haves Ran a private bug bounty program. Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment. Navigated security through a company acquisition. Our Values At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions. You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort. This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast. If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you. What We Offer The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates. At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up: Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals. Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week! Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan. Meal vouchers — Via Swile. Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip. Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide. Our Interview Process We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role. Technical Assessment — 90 minutes. A deeper technical conversation covering core engineering skills, problem-solving, and a technical use case relevant to the role. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit. We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know. Referral Instructions Being referred? title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:<br><br></strong>You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.<br><strong><br>You should apply if:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world</strong>: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work</strong>: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
description: <h3><strong>About CoLab</strong></h3> <p>At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.</p> <p>We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.</p> <p>Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a<a href="https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-wire-news-releases-pmn/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation"> $72M Series C</a>, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (<a href="https://financialpost.com/pmn/business-wire-news-releases-pmn/colab-ranked-number-57-fastest-growing-company-in-north-america-on-the-2025-deloitte-technology-fast-500">Fast 500™</a>), signed multi-year<a href="https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-bombardier-signs-contract-colab-ai-software/"> AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier</a>, and grown to a team of 250+.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.</p> <p>In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.</p> <p>You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.</p> <p>We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.</p> <h2>Our Ideal Candidate</h2> <p>You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.</p> <p>You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.</p> <p>You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.</p> <p>You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.</p> <h2>Job Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.</li> <li>Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.</li> <li>Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.</li> <li>Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.</li> <li>Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.</li> <li>Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <p><strong>Must-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.</li> <li>Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.</li> <li>Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.</li> <li>Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.</li> <li>Strong written communication and documentation skills.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.</li> <li>Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.</li> <li>Located in Switzerland </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.</li> <li>Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.</li> <li>Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Travel Expectations</strong></h2> <p>While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Team Weeks:</strong> Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.</li> <li><strong>On-sites:</strong> This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. That being said, in the event the local customer were to no longer work with us, the following is our standard MFDE travel expectations: “For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on-site during kick-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on-sites involve 2-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on-sites per quarter.”</li> </ul> <h2>Extra Details</h2> <ul> <li>This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.</li> <li>Unlimited paid vacation and extended health benefits </li> </ul> <h2>Equity Note</h2> <p>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Your potential is what matters most to us.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Account Manager, Enterprise
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As an Enterprise Account Manager, you’ll manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers and help them maximise the value they get from Airwallex. Build trusted relationships across commercial, finance, operations, product and technology stakeholders, identifying opportunities to increase adoption, retain customers and expand their use of Airwallex’s products and markets. Own strategic account planning, including customer objectives, stakeholder maps, risks, renewal plans and 12 to 18-month growth opportunities. Lead renewals, commercial negotiations, upsell and cross-sell opportunities, using data and customer insight to improve retention and drive Net Revenue Retention. Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and run effective business reviews that demonstrate value, address risks and align on future priorities. Coordinate escalations, onboarding and complex customer initiatives across Sales, Product Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, KYC and Onboarding, Legal, Customer Success and other internal teams. Maintain accurate CRM records, opportunity tracking and forecasts, while sharing customer feedback that can inform product, operational and go-to-market improvements. You'll work from our Munich office three days a week. What we're looking for Essentials 8+ years of sales or account management experience, including experience managing complex enterprise or strategic customer relationships. A proven track record of retaining and growing existing accounts through renewals, upsell, cross-sell or other expansion motions. Experience managing multi-stakeholder customer relationships, including engagement with senior commercial, finance, operations, product or technology leaders. Strong commercial, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build trusted relationships internally and externally. Experience working cross-functionally to resolve customer issues, manage escalations and deliver complex onboarding, implementation or post-go-live initiatives. Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, B2B SaaS or another technology environment with complex products. Experience with API-enabled products is an advantage. Native German and English fluency required. Preferred Experience managing enterprise accounts in payments, FX, cross-border payments, treasury, cards, embedded finance or other financial infrastructure products. Experience developing strategic account plans, leading QBRs or executive business reviews, and building relationships with C-level stakeholders. A data-driven approach to account health, forecasting, renewal planning and commercial prioritisation, with strong CRM discipline. Curiosity, resilience and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing environment, adapt to evolving priorities and proactively solve complex customer problems. You'll thrive here if You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. Learn more about your team Enterprise Business is about more than closing deals. This team helps large, often multinational organizations solve complex financial challenges that go well beyond a single product decision — moving money globally, managing treasury operations, embedding financial services across borders, and replacing fragmented financial workflows with one global system built to scale. You’ll be helping customers understand what is possible when their financial operations work as one global system. It's a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic thinking with deep product knowledge: comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and the kind of autonomy that comes from being trusted to create value, shape the deal, and move complex opportunities forward rather than follow a rigid playbook. If you want to work on high-consequence deals that genuinely change how large businesses operate financially, this is the place to do it. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description: Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique. L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle. Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an). Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3]. La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques. Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT. La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique. Pour aller plus loin : [1] https://iconic.mines-stetienne.fr/ [2] https://doi.org/10.1038/ s43586-021-00065-8 [3] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-023-00622-5 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous La candidate ou le candidat devra être en cours de formation et d’apprentissage d’un diplôme de Master 2 ou de 3ème année de diplôme d’ingénieurs en Techniques Optiques et Instrumentations. La candidate ou le candidat devra disposer d’une culture solide en Physique/ Science des Matériaux/ (Opto)Électronique par sa formation initiale et/ou son expérience professionnelle. Ce sujet de stage M2 Recherche a vocation d’être poursuivi en cycle de doctorat. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators. The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility. The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program. In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems. The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations. Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated. Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics. title: Product Manager - Surveying & Mapping Drone
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Now we need someone to help decide what we build next. You’ll own the priorities for our data capture platform, from the aircraft to the sensors they carry. You’ll work side by side with customers in the field, Wingtra engineers and Wingtranauts across all business functions. Your job is to find the problems that matter most to our customers and turn good ideas into products people love. Inside Wingtra you’re the voice of the user. Outside you’re the voice of the product. Responsibilities Know your customers. You spend time with survey and mapping teams in the field. You learn how they work, how they buy, what else they could use and what they still can’t do. Set the priorities. You weigh customer value, market opportunity, development effort, price and margin. Then you make a clear call on what comes next. Test ideas early. You try them with customers and engineers, learn fast and adjust. Shape the product development. You steer the capture platform: aircraft, sensors, workflows and data deliverables. You make the performance, reliability and usability trade-offs together with engineering. Take it to market. You launch with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and partners and explain why the product matters. After launch you stay close to field results and keep supporting the product through its lifecycle. Follow the outcomes. You track customer outcomes, usage and commercial results. You use what you learn to pick the next problem to solve with the team. Requirements You have a taste for great products and a relentless drive to understand what makes users love them. You make things happen. You act like an owner and hold yourself accountable to outcomes not output. You care primarily about happy customers and a successful business. You bring people with you. You listen closely, speak clearly and earn trust with customers and engineers, including when you disagree. You find a way forward. You are very comfortable with ambiguity. You work constructively with people and constraints, know when to push and when to adapt. You’ve spent 3+ years developing or deploying hardware products and their software workflows, with clear ownership of product, operational or commercial results. You have a technical background in engineering, geospatial or another technical field. You’re commercially fluent. You read a pricing model, channel margin or renewal term and see why the business cares. You’re fluent in English and happy to travel regularly to customers and partners in the US and Europe. Plus You’ve founded a relevant business of your own, led surveying or drone operations, or built products for geospatial customers. You have hands-on experience with photogrammetry, LiDAR or bringing a commercial robotics product to market. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed . What you will bring: 5+ years of experience in product design with an outstanding portfolio demonstrating visual craft, interaction design, and product thinking (experience in Kiosk, POS, in-store ordering, checkout, or payments is strongly preferred) . Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent practical work experience . Demonstrated product sense with experience writing briefs, establishing roadmap priorities, running experiments, and driving funnel metrics when operating with or without a dedicated PM . Hands-on experience architecting and scaling complex white-label or multi-brand design systems, including working knowledge of EAA/WCAG accessibility and multi-language/RTL support . Code-aware background with a strong understanding of frontend capabilities, technical logic, and performance constraints to effectively partner with engineers on technical implementation . AI-native mindset, leveraging AI tools as a daily productivity lever for research, ideation, spec creation, and high-fidelity prototyping . Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with proven ability to present ideas, negotiate scope trade-offs, align global cross-functional stakeholders, and mentor team members . description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.</strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack</p> <p>The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.</p> <p>The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the <a href="https://github.com/open-telemetry/community#special-interest-groups">OpenTelemetry SIGs</a> to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.</p> <p>In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/docs/languages/python/">OpenTelemetry in Python</a>, with an emphasis on <a href="https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2024/otel-generative-ai/">OpenTelemetry for Generative AI</a>. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. </p> <p>As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.</p> <p>At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas.  They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems.  They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. </p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <p>You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.</li> <li>Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.</li> <li>Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.</li> <li>Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.</li> <li>Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.</li> <li>Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.</li> </ul> <p>As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.</p> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.</li> <li>An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><h2> </h2> <p><strong>This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Spain and Germany.</strong></p> <p><strong>About Grafana Cloud Observability</strong></p> <p>Grafana Cloud is our fully managed observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to use the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.</p> <p>Within the Observability department, we build products that help customers understand and troubleshoot their applications and infrastructure. We work closely with product management, design and other engineering squads to provide seamless and highly curated experiences for our customers.</p> <p><strong>The squad: Database Observability</strong></p> <p>We build and evolve Grafana Cloud Database Observability. We want to help users understand the health and performance of their databases, identify slow queries and troubleshoot issues through clear, actionable insights.</p> <p>As a frontend engineer on the squad, you’ll build experiences that make complex database telemetry easy to explore and understand. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product management and design to take ideas from early exploration through to production and improve them based on customer feedback.</p> <p>Our frontend stack is primarily TypeScript and React, interacting with backends written in Go. Your primary focus will be frontend engineering, with opportunities to work across the stack, contributing to APIs and backend functionality to deliver complete customer experiences. Frontend engineers at Grafana also have opportunities to contribute to open source communities.</p> <p><strong>The opportunity:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own technical projects from problem framing through rollout, including getting user feedback and measuring whether what you shipped actually worked.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management, Product Design and backend engineers to build intuitive user experiences using clean, reusable components, contributing to supporting APIs and backend functionality where needed.</li> <li>Mentor and collaborate with other engineers. Raise the engineering bar through code review, design feedback, pairing on hard problems, and writing that leaves the team better than you found it.</li> <li>Participate in on-call for the software you help build, contributing to incident response and learning from incidents.</li> <li>Provide technical support in customer escalations and help us identify areas of high friction to address.</li> <li>Collaborate with other squads on shared dependencies, contribute to design proposals, and share the team’s work through demos and technical discussions.</li> </ul> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups, always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <p><strong>What makes you a great fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>We highly value those who are <strong>intellectually curious</strong>, who <strong>default to transparency</strong>, possess a high <strong>bias towards action</strong>, and who are also <strong>kind and enjoy working as a team</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Strong frontend engineering experience, with experience across the stack.</strong> You have experience building and maintaining production web applications with React and TypeScript, and are comfortable contributing to backend services and APIs. You value maintainability, readability, automated testing and secure development practices.</li> <li><strong>Technical ownership.</strong> You have solid experience delivering complex projects, mentoring other engineers and helping teammates work more effectively. You communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.</li> <li>You <strong>take responsibility for operating the software you have built</strong>. You have experience being on-call, supporting software in production, ensuring reliability and responding to incidents as needed.</li> <li>You <strong>enjoy working on complex solutions</strong>, building production software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.</li> <li><strong>User focus and pragmatism.</strong> You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.</li> <li><strong>AI experience with a practical mindset.</strong> You use AI coding tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and quality, validate their output, and share useful practices with teammates.</li> <li>You <strong>care about our community</strong> of users and contributors and are keen to be an active Grafana Community Contributor.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points for </strong></p> <ul> <li>Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.</li> <li>An active interest in observability (metrics, logs and traces) and experience with tools like Grafana, Prometheus or other observability platforms.</li> <li>Experience with databases, SQL or database performance monitoring.</li> <li>Experience building backend services in Go.</li> <li>Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).</li> <li>Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is €<span data-sheets-root="1">100,000 - €125,000</span>. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. German language skills (C1/C2), with the ability to confidently engage German-speaking customers, facilitate workshops, and present to executive stakeholders.</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div title: Partner Account Manager - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><h2>Role Overview</h2> <h2>Role:</h2> <p>IonQ is hiring a Senior Quantum Sales Director to drive new and expansion revenue for Capella Data as a Service (DaaS) and satellite systems across EMEA. You will own a portfolio of strategic enterprise, defence and government accounts, selling SAR imagery and analytics subscriptions, tasking capacity and complete satellite systems, and you will report to Garrick Ballantine.</p> <p>This is a quota carrying, hunter oriented role for a seller who can run long cycle capital programmes alongside faster moving data subscriptions, and who can translate space based sensing into mission and business outcomes. The role is remote, employed through an IonQ entity in the UK (Oxford) or Switzerland, with travel of up to 20%.</p> <h2>Responsibilities:</h2> <p>You will own an annual new business and expansion quota across Capella DaaS subscriptions, tasking capacity and satellite system sales within an assigned enterprise, defence and civil government territory in EMEA. You will build and execute account plans for a named portfolio, mapping stakeholders across mission, programme, procurement and technical functions and building executive relationships at several levels in each account.</p> <p>You will sell the full value chain, from SAR data and analytics subscriptions and recurring tasking commitments to ground segment integration and dedicated or jointly owned satellite systems. Working with product, engineering and mission solutions teams, you will bring customer requirements back into the roadmap and represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial conferences.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities include:</h2> <ul> <li>Run complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting through to close, including discovery, technical validation with solutions engineering, pricing, contracting and negotiation of subscription and system purchase agreements.</li> <li>Respond to RFIs, RFPs and government tenders in partnership with capture, proposal and contracts teams, and support prime and subcontractor teaming strategies.</li> <li>Forecast accurately in CRM, keep disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver reliable monthly and quarterly commits.</li> <li>Develop executive relationships across mission, programme, procurement and technical stakeholders in each account.</li> <li>Represent IonQ at industry, defence and geospatial events across EMEA, and feed customer requirements back to product and engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Requirements:</h2> <p>You will bring substantial enterprise sales experience in geospatial data, earth observation, satellite systems, defence technology or adjacent data and SaaS markets, with a consistent record of exceeding quota. You will have closed both recurring data or subscription contracts and large capital or programme based hardware sales, and you will have sold to EMEA and allied government, defence and security customers, with a working knowledge of their procurement frameworks and contracting cycles.</p> <p>You will have command of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDICC or Challenger, with disciplined CRM and forecasting rigour, and the ability to engage credibly with technical and mission stakeholders on remote sensing, SAR, tasking and data delivery workflows. A bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field, and willingness to travel up to 20%, are also required.</p> <h2>You’d be a great fit with:</h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience selling SAR, optical imagery or RF sensing data and analytics.</li> <li>A background in satellite systems, ground segment or space mission integration.</li> <li>Experience in early market development or category creation for an emerging technology.</li> <li>The ability to obtain the relevant national security clearance in your country of employment, such as UK SC or NATO clearance.</li> <li>Established relationships with EMEA government, defence or security customers, including NATO and allied programmes.</li> </ul> <p>The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice.
