About the role: We are looking for a full-time Head of Engineering to help us build a securities Platform for financial institutions, the first API of that kind in Europe. You will lead the Platform Tribe, which comprises three teams. These teams are responsible for critical domains such as Infrastructure, Reliability and Development Tooling and shared libraries, all of which are essential for Upvest’s Investment API. The Platform Tribe exists to give every engineer at Upvest the fastest, safest path from idea to production. We own the foundations that make great engineering possible: the infrastructure teams build on, the tools they build with, the shared libraries that let them move fast without reinventing the wheel, and the observability and reliability practices that keep our systems trustworthy at scale. We measure our success not by what we ship, but by how much faster and more confidently every other engineering team can ship — because when the platform is invisible, it's working. What you’ll do: Own and shape the tribe's roadmap with real autonomy over what we build and why. Partner closely with product tribes to understand their needs and translate them into platform priorities. Work with modern tools and technologies, with real influence over our technical direction and stack. Directly influence the reliability, velocity, and quality of every product we ship. What you bring: Ability to bridge strategic "why" with engineering solutions, actively discussing tradeoffs and proactively suggesting ideas, demonstrating a strong product engineering mindset. Strong interest in Upvest's product domains and a proactive desire to understand the business use cases Upvest enables for clients. Experience in leading and growing larger engineering teams in a technical leadership capacity. Prior experience within the Fintech domain. Strong technical expertise and hands-on experience in developing highly scalable, distributed, asynchronous, and resilient platforms. Strong work ethic and principles such as pragmatism. A security-focused mindset and a high sense of taking ownership. It's great if you have: Experience with API-first and SaaS applications. Experience building and running microservice-based event driven distributed applications. How we Upvest in you: Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market. Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. title: Senior Engineering Manager, Financial Experience
description: We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly. That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns. The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth. The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice. About Nelly We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people. Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality. What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable. Joining us, you will: Lead, inspire and grow a high-performing team of 3–6 software engineers Own hiring for your team, building a team of high-performing engineers Work closely with your product manager to build, launch and improve the financial journey iteratively. That starts at the point of decision, with cost plans, credit checks and installment plans, and runs through to collection, with invoicing, dunning and the processing of billing files Own the quality, reliability and security of your team's products, delivering highly available production systems that handle sensitive financial and patient data Partner with the Financial Platform team to shape the infrastructure your features depend on, and with Nelly's internal teams who use the Backoffice every day. Keep your team at the cutting edge of LLM- and AI-based engineering, testing new ideas and tools as they're released Stay hands-on, developing alongside your team Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives as a member of Nelly's engineering leadership team What you'll bring: 3+ years as an Engineering Manager and 8+ years of overall experience in software development A strong technical background designing, building and owning customer-facing full-stack web applications and the back-end systems behind them, with care for usability and the end-user experience A track record of iterating very quickly: defining small scopes to test hypotheses, running A/B tests, measuring impact, and using the results to decide what to build next Experience with cloud-native development A deep understanding of software engineering processes and team management. Empathy and excellent communication skills, with product, design and non-technical users alike Even better if you have: Experience with billing, invoicing, payments, lending or other financial products. Experience building products for several user groups at once, such as businesses, their staff and their end customers. Familiarity with healthcare billing, for example in German dental or medical practices Our Interview Process: Recruiter screening, 30 minutes Hiring manager conversation, 30 minutes Product interview, 60 minutes Onsite interview - System design, Leadership interview and Meet the CTO What we offer: The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it. Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still. A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. title: Founding Customer Success Manager - DACH
description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role As a Customer Success Manager at Heidi Health, you’ll be the bridge between technology and care - helping hospitals, clinics, and clinicians across Germany adopt and love Heidi. You’ll manage the full customer journey for both public and private hospital deployments, ensuring seamless implementation, strong clinician engagement, and measurable impact on patient care. This role is ideal for someone with a medical background (e.g. former doctor, nurse, or allied health professional) who’s excited to drive digital transformation in healthcare. What you’ll do Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value. Drive strategic adoption: Develop and execute tailored adoption plans to maximise user engagement and satisfaction, enhancing the continued love for Heidi among clinicians. Enhance Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risks and work cross-functionally to deepen product engagement. Customer advocacy: Build executive-level relationships and become the voice of the customer internally, advocating for their needs and priorities and showcasing wins. Continuous engagement: Deliver value at every touchpoint through proactive check-ins, success planning, and education strategies. Think and act strategically to scale your impact. Resolve operational blockers: Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience. Feedback insights: Gather and share insights to influence product development and feature prioritisation. What you'll need 2+ years in a customer success role at a SaaS company, with proven ability to own the full lifecycle A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day. Familiarity with Germany’s healthcare ecosystem (both public and private). Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effortlessly set and manage expectations with customers and cross-functional teams. Highly organised and can confidently manage multiple projects and competing priorities, while maintaining attention to detail and quality. Self-starter with a bias for action, comfortable navigating fast-paced and ambiguous environments. Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects. You default to building over requesting. You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them. Attitude is more important than experience - if you are hungry, competitive, and motivated, with a knack for problem solving and relationship-building, we want to hear from you. How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford. Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander. Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless. Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi? You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally. We take care of you. title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
description: Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI. Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence. Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux. Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles. Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe. Nos valeurs Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler. 1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents. 2. Chacun fait la différence Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse. Le poste Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team. Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison. Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX. Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps. Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques. Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille. Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres. Ton profil Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe. Indispensable Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web. Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale. Un français écrit impeccable. La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général. Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire. Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique. Un plus Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent). Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles. CVE, articles, talks, outils open source. Avantages Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre. Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités. Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk. Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail. Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris. Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant. Le process C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="400" data-local-id="04e5a5743e87">This is a shape-the-team role. norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1426" We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.</li> <li>Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.</li> <li>Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.</li> <li>Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Change Management and Institutional Strengthening</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of change management and implementation approaches to enable government and health facility teams to introduce, adapt and sustain improvements in service delivery.</li> <li>Provide strategic accompaniment and coaching to strengthen government leadership, management and institutional capabilities, including decision-making processes, performance management, accountability mechanisms and continuous improvement practices.</li> <li>Design and guide practical implementation approaches, including change management plans, improvement processes, team-based coaching and mechanisms to address barriers to implementation.</li> <li>Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Implementation and Technical Support</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.</li> <li>Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.</li> <li>Provide technical leadership on country assessments, programme design and implementation planning, ensuring interventions respond to demonstrated system bottlenecks and country priorities.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Learning, Evidence and Innovation</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.</li> <li>Document and synthesise implementation experience, developing practical tools, approaches and lessons that can be adapted and applied across countries and other priority health areas.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Clinical qualification in medicine, nursing, midwifery or a related health profession, with experience in clinical service delivery. An advanced degree in public health, health systems, health management or a related field is desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 10 years of relevant experience in clinical service delivery, health systems strengthening and service delivery transformation, including substantial experience in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working with government institutions and health service managers to strengthen institutional capabilities, embed new ways of working and sustain improvements beyond individual projects.</li> <li>Experience using routine performance data, quality improvement methods, and implementation learning to inform technical decisions, assess results, and adapt interventions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Expertise in applying systems thinking, change management and health systems transformation approaches to diagnose complex service delivery challenges, design practical solutions, and achieve measurable improvements.</li> <li>Proven track record of leading or supporting the implementation of complex health service delivery reforms, including changes to clinical pathways, care models, management practices or health system processes.</li> <li>Deep, nuanced understanding of clinical quality and patient safety, including the organisational, workforce and system factors that influence the reliability and effectiveness of frontline health services.</li> <li>Strong technical leadership, facilitation, coaching, problem-solving, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate resistance to change and work effectively across clinical, technical and management teams.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="TextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142035299 BCX0">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL)</span></span><span data-contrast="none"> is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest </span><span data-contrast="none">health threats. </span><span data-contrast="none">Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. </span><span data-contrast="none">Since 2017, </span><span data-contrast="none">we’ve</span><span data-contrast="none"> worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live</span> <span data-contrast="none">longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p></div><p><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritized, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organized, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  </span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Position Purpose</span></strong></h3> <p>The Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health will provide strategic and technical leadership for RTSL's portfolio to reduce preventable maternal deaths and improve sexual and reproductive health outcomes. The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.</p> <p>The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Work Location: </strong>100% Remote with travel as stated. </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>Duration:</strong> Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.</span></p> <h3><strong><span class="EOP SCXW70040856 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{}">Core Duties and Responsibilities</span></strong></h3> <h4><strong>Strategic</strong> <strong>Leadership</strong> <strong>and Portfolio Management</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.</li> <li>Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Technical Leadership and Program Development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.</li> <li>Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.</li> <li>Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.</li> <li>Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Performance, Learning and Accountability</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.</li> <li>Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Education</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.</li> <li>Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Skills & Abilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.</li> <li>Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.</li> <li>Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="none">Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. title: Regional Director of Sales
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our Regional Director of Enterprise Sales, you act as the primary catalyst for RobCo's enterprise growth across the German market, driving large-scale industrial adoption of our Autonomous Manufacturing Platform. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up. Your Responsibilities Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets. Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises. Champion Technical Solutions: Direct complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles by clearly communicating the strategic, financial, and technical ROI of RobCo's modular robotics and physical AI solutions. Scale Enterprise Footprint: Identify and unlock new market verticals and geographic opportunities across the DACH region to continually expand the sales pipeline. Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering and Product teams to align client requirements with product capabilities and deliver seamless rollouts. Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene, actionable sales reporting, and highly accurate quarterly/annual revenue forecasts in Salesforce. Represent the Brand: Position RobCo as the premier AI-driven automation provider through representation at key industry events, panel discussions, and executive roundtables. Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management. We're looking for someone who has: Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience. Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets. Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors. Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles. Deep understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models. Willingness to travel up to 50-75% within Germany for client meetings, trade shows, onsite evaluations, and international team offsites. Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership mindset, high drive for results, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style in a fast-paced scale-up environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English. Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Recruiter, Commercial
description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Your mission Our market moves fast, and so do we. As our business continues to scale, we're looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Commercial Recruiter to take ownership of hiring across the DACH region. You'll be the driving force behind building our commercial powerhouse — attracting and securing exceptional talent across Sales, Account Management and Business Development . From the initial hiring kick-off to the final signed contract, you'll own the entire recruitment journey. You'll partner closely with business leaders, shape hiring strategies, identify outstanding talent and turn ambitious growth plans into reality. This isn't just about filling vacancies. It's about building the people, teams and capabilities that will define our next chapter. If you love moving fast, building relationships and making great hires happen, we'd love to meet you. What you'll do Own the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close. Hunt passive talent via LinkedIn, referrals, events and direct approach. Interview in German and English and deliver sharp shortlists, fast. Close: negotiate offers, beat counter-offers, keep candidates warm until day one. Advise hiring managers on market, salaries and timelines, and push for quick decisions. Track everything in Ashby and report on pipeline and time-to-hire. You'll thrive here if you have Drive and ownership. Every open role is yours until it's signed. Curiosity. You test new channels, tools and outreach, and keep what works. Hunger to learn. You want to grow fast with a scale-up where things change weekly. What you bring Fluent German (C1 or native) and strong English Experience in recruiting (agency or in-house), ideally commercial or sales roles Proven direct sourcing and closing skills Bonus : start-up or scale-up experience, an energy or B2B background, Ashby know-how. Why Andercore Impact: your hires directly drive our growth Growth: steep learning curve, close to leadership, and a scope that grows with you. Team: driven, international, and we celebrate wins together. Hiring process Intro call → Hiring manager interview → Case study → Meet the team → Offer Ready to Hunt? title: Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager
description: We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science. We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world. World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached. Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you. *Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers. About the role This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US. We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization. This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. What you'll do Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and content syndication channels, owning budget pacing, testing and reporting on CAC, pipeline and ROI Run the webinar program end to end: pick topics and speakers, drive promotion and production, and manage follow-up through to pipeline conversion Partner with Sales to define target account lists and build tiered account-based marketing plays (1:1, 1:few, 1:many), orchestrating multi-channel touches that drive engagement and meetings Use paid and organic social to reach buyers, amplify campaigns and generate demand, working closely with Content and Creative Define KPIs for each program and collaborate with RevOps on dashboards that show what's contributing to pipeline and revenue Stand up new channels and programs, test quickly, cut what isn't working and scale what is Align daily with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps on targets, messaging and handoffs What you'll need 3+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns on LinkedIn, Google or Meta, with a track record of hitting pipeline targets Experience building and scaling a webinar program that converts attendees into pipeline Experience running account-based marketing in close partnership with Sales, including account selection, orchestration and measurement A track record of using paid and organic social as a demand channel Strong analytical skills, comfortable with attribution, funnel metrics and turning data into decisions Working knowledge of marketing automation and CRM tools (for example, HubSpot or Marketo, and Salesforce) Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to align multiple teams around a plan Experience marketing to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders Strong project management instincts; you can run several overlapping campaigns at once and keep timelines, owners and dependencies organized A builder's mindset: you'd rather create programs, processes and playbooks from scratch than inherit a finished machine A collaborative approach; you work across teams every day, share credit, take feedback well, and treat Sales as a partner Comfort using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, for drafting copy, building audience lists and analyzing campaign results Nice to have: Experience marketing to creative, media or enterprise audiences Experience on an early-stage or scaling marketing team Familiarity with AI tools that speed up campaign production and analysis If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't check every box. title: Head of Operations
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The Role The Head of Operations reports to Sauraj (Co-CEO, GTM and Operations) and take ownership of operational excellence company-wide. As Finance, Legal, People, IT and InfoSec, and Compliance grow into their own functions, this person partners with each lead on the operational side of their work and holds the whole together as one system. They lead the operations team and grow it into one fit for a company many times our current size. Builds the operating engine for growth and scale. Owns how the company runs operationally and designs the processes that hold up as headcount, revenue, and complexity grow fast. Everything breaks at each new stage of growth; this person sees it coming and rebuilds ahead of the curve so operations never becomes the ceiling on how fast we can move. Drives operational excellence across every function. Accountable for the operational side of finance, people, legal, and the wider back office, with IT, InfoSec, and compliance covered through the relevant leads. You will set the standard and makes sure nothing important falls between functions. Brings order to ambiguity. Takes the most complex, cross-functional problems and drives them to resolution bringing all the right stakeholder to the table, motivating and inspiring them to come together and deliver the project for everyone’s benefit. Is a decision partner. Frames trade-offs, surfaces risk early, and turns decisions into action, so the leadership team works from reliable data and sound judgment. Builds and inspires the operations team. Hires, develops, and leads an operations team people want to be part of, and sets a standard of execution that raises the bar for everyone who works with them. Who we're looking for Essential: High-growth experience above all. Has operated inside a company through rapid scaling, seen what breaks at each stage, and built the processes and structures that scaled through it. This is the most important thing we are looking for. Global operating experience. Has run operations across multiple countries and regions, comfortable holding a company together across time zones and jurisdictions, not just in a single market. Broad operations ownership. Has driven operational excellence across two or more of finance, people, legal, and business operations as a senior generalist, partnering with specialist leads rather than owning their decisions. A leader operators want to follow. Builds and develops strong teams and is the kind of person other excellent operators want to come and work with. A big plus: Experience in the data, developer tools, or AI market, and comfort working credibly with a technical, research-led team Has built an operations function that grew with a company from startup into real scale What makes someone thrive here: Energized by building the systems that unlock the next stage of growth, not by maintaining the status quo Radical ownership: runs at the most difficult problems and resolves them rather than passing them up Practical and pragmatic: builds processes that scale without bloat, using as much structure as the moment needs Calm and decisive under ambiguity and competing priorities, and sets that standard for the team Location Ideally this person will be located at one of our hubs in New York or Berlin. In exceptional circumstances, we will be able to consider remote/hybrid applications. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. title: Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische
description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische Informationen über unseren Betrieb In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. title: Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution - Manager
description: Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises. L’équipe Financial Expertise & Dispute Resolution de Eight Advisory, acteur reconnu sur son marché et en fort développement, recherche un futur manager. En tant que consultant manager, vous aurez l’opportunité d’intervenir sur des dossiers pluridisciplinaires afin de développer vos expertises et des compétences transverses sur nos métiers du conseil. Au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine, en forte croissance, vous interviendrez sur des missions d’ : · Evaluation de préjudice et de support aux contentieux à forts enjeux pour nos clients (rupture de relations contractuelles, sinistres industriels, litiges post-acquisition, clauses d’ajustement de prix, responsabilité contractuelle, actions en concurrence déloyale et en contrefaçon, etc.). · Expertise financière dans le cadre de revue de grands projets industriels (analyse de l’origine de dérapage et appréciation des risques associés) et d’accompagnement de sociétés dans le cadre de leur changement stratégique (préparation de business plan, aide à la décision dans le cadre de changement structurel). · Investigation financière liée à des problématiques de détournement d’actifs, de manipulation d’états financiers, d’infraction réglementaire etc. · Analyses de gestion en lien avec une mise en responsabilité du dirigeant en cas de défaillance d’entreprise (analyse de l’origine des difficultés, analyse des flux comptables et financiers, détermination de la date de cessation des paiements, etc.). · Ingénierie financière liée à des enjeux haut de bilan et des enjeux opérationnels. description: Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? Our Impact: From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. Our Recognition: DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. The Role: Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. Missions Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after. Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration. Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change. Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine". Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention. Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive. Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification. Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing. Requirements Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English. Experience & Seniority: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead AI-Native Practice: Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain Verification & Quality: Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced? Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role): Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production Product & Team Collaboration: Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why Education: Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments What this role is not We would rather say it up front: It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role. It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one. It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries. Our Tech Stack Backend: Node.js / TypeScript Frontend: Vue.js 3 Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform Cloud: GCP Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing. What we offer Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai; Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote"; Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc... title: Internships & working students at Hypersonica
description: Build what most people think is impossible. Hypersonica is building sovereign European hypersonic capability. We are developing technologies that sit at the edge of what is currently possible, and we are doing it with small, talent dense teams of exceptional people. Our culture takes inspiration from the operating philosophy behind Skunk Works. Small teams. Exceptional talent. High trust. Minimal bureaucracy. The freedom, tools and responsibility to solve problems that have not been solved before. We are looking for interns who want to work in that environment. The Opportunity This is not an internship where you spend three months shadowing someone, preparing slides or waiting to be given something meaningful to do. You will work alongside some of the best engineers and operators in Europe on real problems connected to real hardware and real programmes. Depending on your background, that could mean contributing to areas such as: Engineering, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, materials, avionics, GNC, software, electronics, manufacturing, test, quality, simulation, data or operations. The exact problem matters less than how you approach it. You will be given responsibility early, expected to think independently and encouraged to challenge assumptions. If you see a better way of doing something, we want to hear it. Who we are looking for We are not simply looking for the highest grades. We are looking for people with exceptional potential. People who are deeply curious. People who ask why something has to be done a certain way. People who are not restricted by what they already know, what has been done before, or what others believe to be possible. You might be a great fit if: You learn extraordinarily quickly. You enjoy solving difficult problems with incomplete information. You naturally break problems down to first principles. You build things because you are curious about whether they can be built. You are comfortable being wrong, learning quickly and trying again. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You want feedback and are equally comfortable giving it. You can communicate clearly with people very different from yourself. You want responsibility rather than supervision. You would rather create something than inherit a finished system. What we value Mission alignment. Exceptional subject matter ability. The ability to execute in ambiguity. A builder mindset. A willingness to be on site, close to the hardware and the people building it. We believe in radical candour. High performing people should be able to challenge one another, give direct feedback and change their minds when the evidence demands it. We also believe that the strongest teams are built from different perspectives, backgrounds and ways of thinking. What you will get The chance to work on technology that very few people in the world ever get close to. Direct exposure to exceptional engineers and technical leaders. Real ownership. Real hardware. Real problems. A very steep learning curve. And, if you are exceptional, the opportunity to build a career with us after university. Who should apply We are interested in outstanding students from leading universities across the Germany and Europe, including Oxford, Cambridge, TUM, LMU and others, however: Your university matters less than your ability. Your degree matters less than what you can do with it. Your experience matters less than how quickly you can learn. We are particularly interested in people who can point to something they have built, researched, competed in, broken, redesigned, coded, tested or taught themselves simply because they wanted to understand whether it could be done. Security and Eligibility Requirement Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance. One final thing If you are looking for a comfortable internship with a clearly defined playbook, Hypersonica probably is not for you. If you want to spend your internship surrounded by exceptional people trying to build technology years ahead of where most believe it should be possible, we would like to hear from you. Come and build something that does not yet exist. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: What you'll do Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems. Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance. Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware. Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems. Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces. Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning. Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error. Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software. Who you are An embedded software engineer with 3+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems. Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints. Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability. Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers. Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them. Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries. Veepee is looking for a UX/UI Designer for its Growth Marketing team. Attached to the Lead of UX/UI, the person in this position will be responsible for executing the UX vision for the Veepee front experience. You will ensure the optimization of the customer journey across all Veepee sites by analyzing the performance of each step in the user path. 🎯 TASKS UX/UI Vision and Strategy Deliver the UX/UI front vision for all Veepee sites and apps in collaboration with marketing, business, and Tech teams. Ensure a flawless and coherent user experience across all devices. Contribute to the performance improvement of Veepee platforms by monitoring defined KPIs and business value. Propose best practices and innovative solutions to address e-commerce challenges, specifically the flash sales model. Contribute to the development and maintenance of the group Design System. Collaboration Business - Tech Work closely with Business and Product Tech teams to design UX/UI solutions that balance business expectations with technical complexity. Maintain the quality of business requests and technical deliveries to ensure high-performing evolutions. Support the definition of Tech Roadmaps and the prioritization of projects through design validation and delivery. Team Contribution Participate actively in team rituals and collaborative planning to ensure a performing organization. Maintain high-quality deliveries and stay updated with the latest UX/UI trends and innovations. 👉 MUST HAVE skills At least 3 years of experience as a UX/UI Designer, with a main focus on e-commerce environments. Results-oriented with a capacity to identify and improve process weaknesses. Comfortable working with a wide range of departments, including IT, Data Science, Legal, and Finance. Fluent level of English is a must. International experience is a plus. ❓ TEAM, WHO WE ARE ? title: Site Reliability Engineer- Data Platform  (W/M/X)
description: Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée.
