Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays. 👉 ABOUT THE TEAM The Data Platform team builds and runs the platform behind Veepee's data: streaming, query engine, data catalog, storage and Kubernetes. It serves every data team, from BI and analytics to data science, pricing and personalisation. We are in the middle of our move from GCP to a self-hosted, open-source data platform built on Kafka, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris, Ceph and Kubernetes. Projects like this are rare. You'll help build it, make it production-grade and keep it reliable. We also work AI-first. We use Claude and GitHub Copilot every day, expose our platform to AI agents through MCP servers, and keep an AI-ready knowledge base. 🎯 TASK - Run and improve the reliability of our data platform on Kubernetes: availability, performance, capacity, cost. - Define and track SLOs, and improve monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana) so that fewer, more useful alerts reach people. - Automate everything you can: infrastructure as code (Terraform, Crossplane), GitOps (ArgoCD), and CI/CD (GitLab). - Take part in on-call [rotation details], lead incidents and write blameless postmortems that lead to lasting fixes. - Work with data engineers and other data teams on production readiness, migrations and tooling. - Try out AI in operations: agents that investigate incidents, MCP tools, automated runbooks. 👉 MUST HAVE SKILLS - Kubernetes in production: you have run clusters and the workloads on them, not only deployed to them. - Infrastructure as code and GitOps: Terraform, plus ArgoCD or a similar tool. - Observability: Prometheus and Grafana, SLOs, and alerting that people actually act on. - On-call and incident management: real incidents handled, root causes found, postmortems written. - Coding: Go or Python for automation and tooling, plus solid Linux and networking basics. - CI/CD: GitLab CI or similar. - Curiosity about AI: you already use AI assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar) in your daily work, and you want to find out how they can change the way we run platforms. - Professional English, written and spoken. 👉 NICE TO HAVE SKILLS - Kafka (KRaft, Kafka Connect) - Trino, Opensource : Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris - Object storage (Ceph, S3) and Postgres (Patroni) - Crossplane, OPA - GCP - FinOps practices - English ✅ BENEFITS 👉 Variable bonus 👉 Profit-sharing and incentive schemes 👉 Remote work possible for up to 2 days per week 👉 Online language-learning platform 👉 Works Council (CSE) with a wide range of benefits 👉 CESU vouchers (service vouchers) and holiday vouchers 👉 Access to corporate dining facilities and smart fridges (Foodles, Kumo, Bolk) 👉 Access to an on-site gym ⚙️ RECRUITMENT PROCESS 30-minute HR Screen with a Talent Acquisition Partner Interview with the Hiring Manager Business & Technical Interview with local Team The Veepee Group processes your data collected as part of the management of your recruitment in order to manage your application file for the position for which you have applied. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: About the role Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast. We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team. Your core responsibilities will be to: Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers Requirements You’re a great match if you: Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production. Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment Example Projects Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine Our Stack Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform Details The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day. We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here . Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI! About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. Denis Charrier - Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience. Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline. You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO. What you will do: CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release. Mechanism & kinematics. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured. Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions. Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling. Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes. Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause. Documentation & release. Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or from other similar roles. Proven track record of managing a portfolio of medium to large enterprise customers, delivering measurable customer value, and driving retention and account growth. Commercially minded, with a strong ability to build lasting customer relationships and identify opportunities for growth. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels. A proactive, ambitious, and results-driven approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing environment. A collaborative team player who works well in an international, distributed environment. Experience in SaaS and having industry domain knowledge are a plus. Familiarity with the MEDDICC methodology is a plus. Benefits A competitive compensation package Buddy program Being part of a vibrant, diverse and passionate team Social and company events About Kahoot! The Kahoot! Group is on a mission to make learning awesome! We want to empower everyone, including children, students, and employees to unlock their full learning potential. Our Kahoot! learning platform makes it easy for any individual or corporation to create, share, and host learning sessions that drive compelling engagement. Since launching in 2013, Kahoot! has become a global leader, hosting hundreds of millions of sessions with over 12 billion cumulative participants across 200+ countries and regions. The Kahoot! Group includes Clever, the top US K-12 EdTech platform, and popular learning apps like DragonBox, Poio, Drops, Actimo and Motimate. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, we also have offices in the US, UK, France, Finland, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Estonia, Denmark, Spain, and Poland. Let’s play! Our K!rew At the Kahoot! With a global team of more than 600 employees representing over 50 different nationalities, we’re a diverse and fun bunch of people! We work hard and celebrate our wins, tackle challenges with original ideas and learn something new every day. We are driven by our mission and guided by our values: playful, curious and inclusive. If you talk to anyone working in the Kahoot! Group, they will tell you that one of the greatest perks is being able to see how the work you do puts a smile on the face of kids, teachers and learners all around the world. title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As a Senior AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus. What we offer Become part of an AI revolution! 30 days of paid vacation Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub Mental health support through nilo.health Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket Budget for additional technical equipment Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model JobRad® Bike Lease Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About The Job As a Forward Software Engineer, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on. You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements. We're looking for a strong software engineer who has shipped agentic or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of agents that work in the demo and fall apart on real tasks: tool calls that fail silently, loops that never end, and quality that drifts after launch. That production depth is your edge. You build across the stack, and you'd rather ship a plain UI on a solid foundation than a polished UI on a fragile one. You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it. Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. You help set the standard for how the team builds agents that are reliable, observable, and safe to run against sensitive systems. Security is a big part of where we're heading. If you're drawn to it, that's a strong plus. You might come from security with a real interest in AI engineering, or from AI engineering with a real interest in security. Both paths fit. Curiosity about how systems break, and a habit of learning fast from the people who know the domain, matter. Experience at a security company counts too. What you will do Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production. Design the agent architecture: orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, and the interfaces between agents and the systems they act on. Build across the stack, from backend services and APIs to the interfaces people use to work with agents. Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time. Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start. Build security into agents from day one: permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trails for agents that touch sensitive systems. Build the evaluation loop: task-level evals, tracing, and checks that catch agent failures and quality drift before customers do. Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on. What We're Looking For You have 5+ years building production software, with at least one agentic or GenAI system shipped to production that you ran after launch. You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished. You have hands-on depth in agent design: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the ways agents fail in the real world. You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English. You ship in increments and are obsessed with time to value You have product judgment: you learn what users need through customer-facing teams, cut scope hard, and care how the result feels to use. Ideally you have Open-source contributions, particularly in agents or LLMs. Experience deploying and running what you build: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS, GCP, or Azure. A security background in application, cloud, or AI security, such as prompt injection, securing agents, or supply chain (SBOM, SLSA). If that's you, flag it in your application. Experience building for security workflows, such as alert triage, threat hunting, or investigation agents, or with SIEM, XDR, or SOAR tooling. How We Work in Applied AI We care about people and outputs. What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care. No politics. Low ego, high standards. We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken. Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team; Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? title: Solution Engineer
description: À propos de Dastra Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA. Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels. Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques. Ton rôle chez Dastra À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes. Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients. En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision. Tes missions Qualifier les besoins techniques : conduire les phases de Technical Discovery , analyser les environnements IT des prospects et échanger avec leurs interlocuteurs techniques (DSI, RSSI, équipes IT), en complément de la qualification business réalisée par les Sales. Démontrer la valeur de Dastra : concevoir des environnements de démonstration personnalisés, construire des cas d'usage pertinents et animer des démonstrations adaptées aux enjeux métiers et techniques des clients. Piloter les Proof of Concept (POC) : définir les critères de succès, organiser les validations techniques et apporter les preuves concrètes de l'adéquation de notre solution aux besoins du client. Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects. Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients. Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature. Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique. Le profil que nous recherchons Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique , idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B . Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes , avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants. Tu possèdes une solide compréhension des architectures SaaS, des intégrations, des problématiques de sécurité et des environnements IT. Tu connais les enjeux de Privacy, conformité, GRC ou cybersécurité , et sais les traduire en solutions concrètes pour tes clients. Tu combines expertise technique, sens commercial et excellente communication : tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, convaincre et adapter ton discours à tes interlocuteurs. Tu fais preuve d'agilité intellectuelle, de pédagogie, de pragmatisme et de sang-froid, y compris lors de démonstrations en direct. Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l'anglais (niveau C2) pour évoluer dans un environnement international. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra. Un environnement stimulant : évoluer à l'intersection du SaaS, de la protection des données, de la cybersécurité et de l'intelligence artificielle. Explorer les liens entre les méthodes développées et d’autres problématiques de la théorie de l’information quantique et de la physique mathématique. Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs scientifiques et des livrables du projet de recherche. Présenter et discuter les résultats de recherche au sein de l’équipe ainsi qu’avec des collaborateurs extérieurs. Préparer des publications scientifiques présentant les résultats des travaux de recherche. 2. Assurer des activités d’enseignement, d’encadrement et de tutorat Assurer des séances de travaux dirigés dans le cadre d’un cours de théorie de l’information quantique. Préparer et mettre à jour des feuilles d’exercices, des corrigés et d’autres supports pédagogiques pour ce cours. Encadrer des projets étudiants et, le cas échéant, des stages de recherche. Contribuer à l’accompagnement scientifique de doctorants et d’autres jeunes chercheurs travaillant sur des thématiques connexes. 3. Contribuer à la notoriété de Télécom SudParis, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris Publier les résultats des travaux de recherche dans des revues internationales à comité de lecture et dans des actes de conférences. Présenter les résultats de recherche lors de conférences internationales, d’ateliers, de séminaires et de rencontres scientifiques. Participer à des collaborations scientifiques avec des institutions académiques et des centres de recherche en France et à l’étranger. Contribuer à l’animation scientifique et à la visibilité du département et de l’établissement. 4. Activités diverses Participer aux activités scientifiques et académiques du département et de l’établissement. Participer aux séminaires de recherche, aux réunions de projet et aux autres activités scientifiques collectives. Rendre compte de l’avancement et des résultats des activités de recherche dont il ou elle a la charge. Formation Doctorat en physique, mathématiques, informatique, ingénierie, ou dans un domaine connexe pertinent pour la théorie de l’information quantique Expérience de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique, physique mathématique, théorie de la communication quantique, optique quantique théorique, ou dans un domaine étroitement lié Expérience des approches analytiques et mathématiques appliquées à des problèmes de théorie de l’information quantique. Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables Maîtrise de l’anglais écrit et oral. Solides connaissances scientifiques en théorie de l’information quantique. Solides compétences mathématiques et analytiques. Connaissance de la mécanique quantique et de la théorie de l’information quantique. Connaissance des canaux quantiques, des entropies quantiques et des méthodes issues de la théorie de l’information. Connaissance des systèmes quantiques bosoniques. Capacité à formuler et à traiter de manière autonome des problèmes théoriques complexes. Excellentes capacités de communication et de rédaction scientifiques. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables Expérience de la théorie de la majorisation, des inégalités matricielles ou des inégalités d’opérateurs en information quantique Connaissance de l’information quantique non gaussienne Expérience des capacités de communication quantique ou de problématiques connexes en théorie de Shannon quantique Maîtrise ou familiarité avec des outils symboliques ou numériques permettant d’explorer des problèmes théoriques, tels que Python, Mathematica ou MATLAB Capacités et aptitudes Capacité à travailler de manière autonome ainsi qu’en collaboration au sein d’une équipe de recherche. Capacité à interagir efficacement avec des chercheurs issus de différents domaines scientifiques. Capacité à synthétiser des idées scientifiques complexes et à rédiger des publications et rapports scientifiques de grande qualité. Bonnes capacités d’organisation. Esprit d’initiative, rigueur et curiosité intellectuelle. Créativité dans l’approche de problèmes théoriques ouverts. Autonomie et motivation. title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
description: Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit. The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible. The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability. A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning. Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects. Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research. Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations. Starting date: Fall 2026 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer (Electro-mechanical)
description: With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation. At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. For the expansion of our team, we are seeking to hire in Geneva a dynamic and motivated Senior R&D Engineer. As a Senior Multiphysics R&D Engineer, you will be involved with the R&D team in the development of cutting-edge high-speed switching devices such as high-speed DC circuit breakers, contributing to the full product lifecycle: from design to application. You will work at the intersection of electrical and mechanical engineering, bringing expertise in power electronics, dielectrics and thermal advanced modeling, playing a key role in shaping the future of medium voltage switching technology. Main Responsibilities: Contribute to innovative R&D projects focused on high-speed circuit breakers and related switching technologies. Design and simulate electrical switching systems using MATLAB/Simulink, COMSOL MultiPhysics including electromagnetic, thermal, material science and dielectric behavior. Define and execute test plans for prototypes, including dielectric, thermal, and mechanical validation. Interface with cross-functional teams including mechanical, electrical and electronics engineers. Collaborate with manufacturing teams to optimize material processing and industrialization. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical strategy and innovation roadmaps. Contribute to patent filings, technical documentation, and compliance with IEC/IEEE standards. Develop and validate electronic control boards for switching and protection systems. Requirements Minimum 8 years of experience in R&D for low voltage and/or medium voltage electric equipment. Good understanding of Railway protection systems – Modern DC microgrids. English fluent mandatory, French strong plus. Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Applied Physics or similar. Strong understanding of electro-mechanical and magnetic systems. Strong plus: Experience with testing and validation in high-voltage environments. Knowledge of High-speed DC circuit breakers. Plus: Good knowledge in power electronics switching devices. Thermal and dielectric analysis. Modeling and simulation in MATLAB/Simulink - COMSOL. Material processing and manufacturing techniques. Electronic board design and integration. CAD 3D design tools (SolidWorks). Curious, attentive to detail, team player. Benefits We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.</p> <p>We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our <a href="https://techcrunch.com/2022/09/21/ledgy-a-carta-for-european-startups-to-manage-equity-and-cap-tables-raises-22m-from-nea-sequoia-and-more/">$22m Series B</a> round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.</p> <p>We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.</p> <p> </p></div><p> </p> <h2 id="about-the-role">About the Role</h2> <p>As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.</p> <p>Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.</p> <p><strong>The team you'll join:</strong> Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-work-on">What You'll Work On</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cloud infrastructure.</strong> Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.</li> <li><strong>CI/CD and developer experience.</strong> Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.</li> <li><strong>Observability.</strong> Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.</li> <li><strong>Security and automation.</strong> Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.</li> </ul> <p>You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.</p> <h2 id="youll-thrive-in-this-role-if-you">You'll Thrive in This Role If You</h2> <p>Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.</p> <ul> <li>Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems</li> <li>Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform</li> <li>Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience</li> <li>Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code</li> <li>Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security</li> <li>Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost</li> <li>Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required</li> </ul> <p>Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.</p> <h2 id="our-tech-stack">Our Tech Stack</h2> <p>We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.</p> <p>You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.</p> <h2 id="what-your-journey-could-look-like">What Your Journey Could Look Like</h2> <p><strong>First 30 days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy</li> <li>Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement</li> <li>Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 3 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design</li> <li>Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers</li> <li>Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>First 6-12 months:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption</li> <li>Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost</li> <li>Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers</li> </ul> <h2 id="the-interview-process">The interview process</h2> <p> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Getting to know you (45 min):</strong> Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role</li> <li><strong>Live Coding (60 min):</strong> An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.</li> <li><strong>System Design (60 min):</strong> A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice</li> <li><strong>DDSA (45 min):</strong> A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.</li> <li><strong>Culture Interview:</strong> A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values</li> <li><strong>Offer</strong> 🎉</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2 id="being-part-of-ledgy-means">Being part of Ledgy means</h2> <ul> <li>Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.</li> <li>We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.</li> <li>This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio. Key Responsibilities · Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover. · Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods. · Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements. · Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects. · Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution. · Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results. · Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early. · Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes. · Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery. · Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders. · Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps. · Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities. What You’ll Bring · Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes. · A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. · Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems. · Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles. · Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings. · Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements. · Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance. · Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics. · Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners. · Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%). What We Offer · The opportunity to play a key role in delivering critical digital infrastructure across EMEA. · The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business. · Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally. About STACK Infrastructure STACK Infrastructure is a global digital infrastructure partner to the world’s most innovative companies. We develop, build and operate Data Centres designed to meet the scale, performance and sustainability requirements of today’s leading technology businesses. Across EMEA, our teams work together to deliver resilient, high-quality infrastructure and create long-term value for our customers and communities. description: You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations. Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed. Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor. Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better. Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck. You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it You're open to travel 30-50% of the time This is how we'll set you up in your first six months: Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there. Why now? AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: Data: years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds. Brand: half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel. Licences: stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop. Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join. What we offer We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to. We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day. Read more about our values here . The role The CEO Office owns Finary's most important strategic projects, the delivery of the business plan, company’s operating rituals and runs the board and investor relations. Today one Chief of Staff carries all of it. You join as a real partner: you own a share of these projects from day one and move key topics forward fast, side by side with the Chief of Staff and the CEO. What you will do Take one area of the company and measurably improve its metrics. Lead the analyses behind big decisions: business plan updates, international expansion, new offers and segments. You turn a question into a recommendation the leadership team can act on. Run the board operating rhythm and the monthly reporting, with numbers you have checked yourself. Work with Finance on budget, targets, forecast and costs. Own Finary's operating rituals (weekly kick-off, all-hands, performance reviews, leadership topics) and make them sharper. What success looks like After 1 month: you know Finary's business, numbers and new vision, and you run the operating rituals. After 3 months: you co-run the board and the monthly reporting, and the team you focus on performs measurably better. After 6 months: you are a multiplier across teams. The CEO Office delivers more, faster. Who you are You have a track record of winning: a competition, a sport, a project where you went further than anyone expected. You own outcomes, not tasks. You come back with proposals, not questions. You are extremely rigorous with numbers: models, Excel, data. Nothing leaves your hands unchecked. You write short, clear English that a board member reads in 5 minutes. You are an AI pioneer. You build trust fast and get things done through people, without authority. You are discreet and put the company first. You are in your final year or a recent graduate of a top business or engineering school, fluent in French and English. Bonus: a first internship in strategy consulting, ideally followed by startup ops or product. Being a Finary user. Practical details 6-month end-of-studies internship or graduate program, starting January 2027. Onsite in Paris, every day, with the CEO Office. Process: application review, screening call, case study with a debrief with the Chief of Staff and the CEO, then a culture fit interview. title: Scriptwriter intern
description: La mission de Finary Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun. Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité. Pourquoi maintenant ? Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise). En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre. Ce que nous offrons Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment. Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour. Découvrez nos valeurs ici . --- LE POSTE Finary Media fait la première chaîne YouTube d’éducation financière en France : 880 000 abonnés et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, tout est produit en interne. Chaque vidéo est traitée comme un produit : on mesure, on itère, on améliore. Rattaché·e à Rayan , tu travailles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne d’écriture : recherche, script, vérification, packaging et présentation face caméra. TES MISSIONS Mener la recherche sur des sujets d’investissement et de patrimoine (ETF, assurance-vie, immobilier, fiscalité), à partir de sources fiables, et vérifier chaque donnée. Rédiger des scripts pour la chaîne YouTube et les formats courts, puis les faire évoluer avec l’auteur senior jusqu’à la version validée. Présenter tes scripts face caméra. Concevoir le packaging des vidéos : titres, accroches, angles de miniature. Intégrer l’IA à chaque étape de la production et développer tes propres outils : prompts structurés, workflows, automatisations. CE QUE CE STAGE T’APPORTE Écrire pour une audience de plusieurs centaines de milliers de personnes, avec des résultats mesurés sur chaque vidéo. Une formation à la présentation face caméra, au sein d’une équipe qui tourne chaque semaine. La rigueur d’une rédaction financière, où aucune approximation n’est acceptée. Une méthode de production où l’IA prend en charge une grande partie de la recherche et de la mise en forme. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Étudiant·e en Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de journalisme, en école de commerce ou en master de finance ou d’économie, avec une convention de stage. Une solide culture financière : tu maîtrises les fondamentaux de l’épargne et de l’investissement (enveloppes fiscales, classes d’actifs, fiscalité du patrimoine) et tu sais les rendre accessibles. Une plume démontrée : des textes publiés que tu peux nous montrer (média étudiant, blog, newsletter, LinkedIn, rédaction en stage). Nous évaluons la qualité de l’écriture et ta capacité à retenir le lecteur. Une rigueur factuelle sans faille : chaque chiffre est sourcé et vérifié avant publication. Une pratique avancée de l’IA : au-delà d’un usage conversationnel, tu as déjà conçu des prompts structurés, des workflows ou des automatisations pour produire mieux et plus vite. L’aisance face caméra, qui est un prérequis du poste. Un vrai esprit de synthèse, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. La capacité à intégrer un retour rapidement et à le traduire dans la version suivante. ATOUTS APPRÉCIÉS Une expérience vidéo : tournage, présentation ou montage. Des compétences techniques : code, outils no-code, création d’outils d’analyse financière. Une première expérience en finance, dans un média ou dans une fintech. Entretiens Les entretiens avec les candidat·es francophones se déroulent en français. En tant qu’entreprise internationale, nous attendons un niveau d’anglais professionnel, que nous évaluons lors de l’entretien de présélection. Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment. Process & Operations Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes. Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes. Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs. Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes. Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation. Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field. Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams. Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
description: We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics. What is your Day to Day Mission: Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs. Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time. What you bring to the team: Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement). System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques. Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation. State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints. Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments. You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell. You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip. You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do. You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings. Bonus points You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one. You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge Competitive compensation Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards Team retreats across the globe Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects. Recent projects run by interns: Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34. Took a new product from first customer call to production launch. Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy. Built the sales case behind our largest deals. Who Will Thrive At Augustus We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits: American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low. Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment. Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team. Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent. This role is for you if: You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most. Designing multi-layer, high-density PCBs from schematic capture through layout and release. Routing high-speed digital buses (PCIe Gen3/Gen4, MIPI CSI/DSI, USB 3.x) with proper impedance control and length matching. Experience with DC power filtering and EMI mitigation for battery-powered systems with noisy motor/ESC loads. Proficiency in Altium and/or KiCad, plus a circuit simulation tool. A portfolio of PCB projects you've designed and brought up yourself — we will ask to see it. Experience with SBC/embedded carrier boards (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Rockchip) and camera/sensor interfacing (MIPI CSI cabling, I²C buses) is a plus.
