Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.</p> <p>You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.</li> <li>Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.</li> <li>Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.</li> <li>Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.</li> <li>Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.</li> <li>Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion.</li> <li>Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling.</li> <li>Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short.</li> <li>Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab's values.</li> <li>Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Data Platform team within Enterprise Data is responsible for a scalable, reliable and secure data platform for data analytics at GitLab. That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. We make data reliable, secure and ready for analytics, data science and AI tools. As more questions go straight to AI tools and agents, the platform underneath has to be more reliable, better governed and more cost-efficient than ever. We're fully remote and globally distributed, and work asynchronously through issues, merge requests and the handbook.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/">Infrastructure</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/">Customer Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> <li value="5">Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through <a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w">pairing sessions</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart">stable counterpart</a> relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.</p> <p>You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</p> <p>GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> <li value="9">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Technical Program Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Technical Program Management practices by documenting processes, sharing learnings, and improving how R&D programs run across GitLab.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in technical program management, project management, software engineering, or similar Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: </strong>NYC, SF, LA, Chicago</h3> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>The Sr. Director of Customer Engineering will partner directly with the Area Vice President of Sales for Digital Native/AI to lead one of Cloudflare’s fastest-growing market segments. <li>Set the technical standard for edge and AI solution design (Cloudflare Workers, Workers AI, Vectorize, Hyperdrive, R2, and edge inference pipelines).</li> <li>Serve as executive sponsor on to prioritize regional requirements and advocate for investments in serverless and AI-driven security capabilities.</li> <li>Cultivate Partner Ecosystems: Partner closely with Channel, Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), and local ecosystem partners across the Digital Native segment to define joint technical strategies and scale Cloudflare’s market reach through automated solution frameworks.</li> record of successfully partnering with Account Executives, Customer Success teams, and executive-level stakeholders to drive enterprise revenue and successful customer outcomes.</li> <li>Escalation & Conflict Resolution: Demonstrable experience in successfully navigating, de-escalating, and solving complex technical escalations, utilizing automated escalation frameworks and cross-functional AI reviewer pipelines.</li> <li>Enterprise Contract & Process Management: Strong experience supporting enterprise contract management, commercial negotiations, compliance, or project management title: Senior Customer Engineer - Vancouver BC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Vancouver, BC</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p> </p> <p style="margin: 0in; font-family: Arial; font-size: 11.0pt; color: #222222;">This role will require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other in-person team meetings, within the assigned territory. For this reason, candidates must have reliable personal or local public transportation to complete all required travel. Required travel is reimbursable in accordance with the Company's Travel & Expense Policy, as it may be amended from time to time. </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Specialist, Assurance and Audit Coordination
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who we are </strong></h4> <p>We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.</p> <p> </p> <p>Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Your mission</strong> </p> <p>You drive the day-to-day coordination of complex audits, examinations, and remediation tracking across Information Security, ICT risk, TPRM, and operational resilience. You will manage the end-to-end lifecycle of evidence collection, ensuring every request, decision, and finding remains perfectly traceable and audit-ready. By supporting domain owners and executing a highly controlled intake process, you will ensure our leadership has timely, accurate information for critical decisions and risk escalation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Engagement & Evidence Workflow Management:</strong> Operate the daily intake process for new engagements and evidence requests. Coordinate directly with domain and control owners to collect, organize, and quality-check evidence for completeness and version control against agreed internal deadlines.</li> <li><strong>Audit Portfolio Administration:</strong> Maintain the centralized audit calendar, engagement register, and findings inventory. Ensure precise tracking of scope, owners, requests, dependencies, and current status across all regulatory and internal assurance activities.</li> <li><strong>Documentation & Auditor-Facing Preparation:</strong> Prepare high-quality evidence packs, response trackers, meeting agendas, action logs, and status reporting. Ensure all submissions to auditors, regulators, and management are accurate, secure, and properly approved by domain owners.</li> <li><strong>Remediation Tracking & Control Integration:</strong> Track remediation plans and final closure evidence, identifying overdue or incomplete actions early. Partner with control-testing teams to coordinate the reuse of relevant evidence and proactively escalate delivery risks to the Audit Management Lead.</li> <li><strong>Process Optimization & Tooling:</strong> Administer the agreed workflow within existing GRC, ticketing, and collaboration tools. Consistently apply the audit-governance process while identifying safe opportunities to automate repetitive administrative work and reduce avoidable evidence rework.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>4–7 years of relevant experience in audit coordination, technology risk, information security GRC, regulatory compliance, control assurance, or structured programme management.</li> <li>Proven track record of managing competing deadlines, handling sensitive information with sound judgement, and confidently following up with cross-functional stakeholders to drive action.</li> <li>Strong understanding of audit evidence standards, control documentation, and the findings management lifecycle within a regulated environment.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or third-party risk management is highly beneficial.</li> <li>Excellent organization, attention to detail, and written communication in professional English (German is beneficial), with the ability to maintain highly reliable records and response trackers.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <ul> <li description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Telnyx</strong></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/our-network"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">private, global, multi-cloud IP network</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">, to bringing </span></em><a href="https://telnyx.com/resources/about-edge-connectivity"><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">hyperlocal edge</span></em></a><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.</span></em></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.</span></em></p></div><p data-start="3512" data-end="3596"> </p> <h3> </h3> <div id="message-list_1789158556.563599"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role</strong><br><br>We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.<br><br>This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.<br><br>You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.<br><br><em>The Pod Model</em><br><br><em>Enterprise AE</em> — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .<br><br><em>Forward Deployed Engineer</em> — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.<br><br>We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong><br><br>• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand<br>• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC<br>• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it<br>• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys<br>• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing<br>• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't<br>• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades<br>• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both<br>• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)<br>• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live<br>• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable<br>• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div id="message-list_1789158556.594389"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div>• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams<br><br><strong>What We're Looking For</strong><br><br>• CS degree or equivalent experience<br>• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)<br>• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)<br>• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency<br>• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story<br>• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like<br>• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count<br>• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency<br>• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts<br>• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems<br>• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own<br>• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week<br>• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause<br>• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations<br>• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and German. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.<br>• Based in Munich, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland<br>• Legally authorized to work in Germany, or eligible for sponsorship<br><br><em>Bonus Points For</em><br><br>• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems<br>• Building eval sets for a specific domain<br>• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management<br>• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Gaia-X, Aleph Alpha, European LLM projects)<br>• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)<br>• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)<br>• ETL and data wrangling experience<br>• CI/CD pipeline design and automation<br>• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS<br>• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and DACH regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data sovereignty and localization requirements, Swiss data protection)<br>• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h3> </h3> <p><em>#LI-RH1</em></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Mission Brief </strong></p> <p>We move fast, build rockets, and need IT that works. This is an on-site role at our new HQ in Parsdorf. As Working Student IT Helpdesk, you will be the hands-on all-rounder who helps keep our office and shop floor running: laptops, accounts, accessories, printers, meeting rooms, shop floor devices, and whatever blocks people from getting work done.</p> <p>This is not a ticket-forwarding role. You go where the problem is, fix what you can, and make sure our teams have the tools they need to execute.</p> <p> </p> <p>Your Role in Our Space Mission: </p> <ul> <li>Set up laptops, accounts, phones, peripherals, and standard workplace equipment.</li> <li>Support users directly in the office and on the shop floor - fast, practical, hands-on.</li> <li>Troubleshoot common IT issues across Windows, Microsoft 365, printers, meeting rooms, networks, and shop floor devices.</li> <li>Prepare, hand out, collect, and maintain IT equipment.</li> <li>Document simple fixes, recurring issues, and hardware inventory cleanly.</li> <li>Help the IT team improve basic processes instead of repeating the same manual work forever.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist </strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled as a student in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>Hands-on IT experience and the willingness to fix things, instead of just talking about them.</li> <li>Basic understanding of Windows, Microsoft 365, hardware setup, networks, and common workplace IT issues.</li> <li>Comfortable walking across office, production, and test areas to solve You have a refined visual eye and strong creative judgment, allowing you to create high-quality content yourself and recognize what makes an image or video successful. Beyond creating individual assets, a key part of your role is translating creative direction and successful approaches into reliable, production-ready workflows that expand the Studio's AI capabilities. Working closely with art directors, photographers, retouchers, video, design, and tech, you identify where AI can improve creative possibilities, production efficiency, and scale. You help define best practices, evaluate emerging technologies, and continuously develop how AI is used in visual production across the Studio.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Create high-quality AI-powered content across commercial photography and video, including lifestyle, food, product, and campaign content, translating creative direction into assets ready for real production and marketing use.</li> <li>Develop and refine AI content creation workflows, prompts, techniques, and reusable approaches using tools such as Krea, Higgsfield, Claude, ComfyUI, and emerging platforms.</li> <li>Work closely with Art Directors, Photographers, Video, Design, and Post-Production to translate creative concepts and established visual approaches into scalable AI-powered production workflows.</li> <li>Use your creative judgment and production experience to continuously improve visual quality, realism, consistency, and efficiency across AI-generated content.</li> <li>Partner with Workflow Specialists to identify automation opportunities and help turn successful creative processes into scalable or automated content-generation workflows.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging AI models, tools, and techniques, testing their practical value and introducing those that meaningfully improve creative output or production.</li> <li>Define and share best practices, standards, and documentation for AI content creation, and support colleagues in developing their AI capabilities.</li> <li>Stay closely connected to developments in generative AI, actively experimenting with new approaches and identifying opportunities to expand what the Studio can create.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of professional experience in commercial photography, retouching, art direction, or a closely related visual production discipline</strong>, with a strong understanding of professional photography and/or video production.</li> <li>Advanced hands-on experience creating high-quality visual content with generative AI tools and integrating AI into real creative or production workflows.</li> <li><strong>A refined visual eye and strong creative judgment</strong>, with an excellent understanding of photography, composition, lighting, colour, visual storytelling, realism, and what makes commercial imagery feel premium and intentional.</li> <li>Proven ability to interpret creative briefs and translate creative direction into high-quality visual content and repeatable production approaches.</li> <li>Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across creative, production, and technical teams.</li> <li>You are proactive, curious, and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership, an experimental mindset, and genuine enthusiasm for emerging AI technologies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please include a portfolio of your recent and relevant work.</strong></p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>You own our data-collection flights. When the perception team needs a specific dataset — a new camera at a new angle, a lidar over specific terrain, a thermal sensor at dusk — you plan the campaign, configure and tune the platform, fly the mission, and bring clean data home. Our hardware engineer builds the rigs and mounts, our robotics engineer makes the sensors record — you make it all fly, reliably, again and again. This is a role for someone with real stick time and real PX4/ArduPilot depth: not a desk job with occasional field trips, but the other way around.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan and execute field data-collection campaigns across Europe: flight planning, site assessment, pre-flight checks, piloting, logging, and post-flight data offload</li> <li>Configure, tune, and troubleshoot PX4/ArduPilot flight stacks for stable, repeatable data-collection flights</li> <li>Analyze flight logs to diagnose issues and continuously improve platform reliability</li> <li>Operate sensor payloads (cameras, gimbals, lidar, GNSS/IMU) during missions and verify recordings on-site</li> <li>Keep the fleet mission-ready: maintenance, repairs, spare parts, battery management, and configuration control</li> <li>Work with our hardware and robotics engineers on payload integration — you define what the platform needs to fly well</li> <li>Maintain flight logs and campaign documentation so every flight produces usable, traceable data</li> <li>Ensure operations comply with aviation regulations (EU drone rules) and internal safety procedures</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></p> <ul> <li>Confident, experienced drone pilot with substantial real-world flight hours (multirotor; title: Senior Software Engineer - Network Connectivity (Go/Rust)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal </li> <li>London, UK </li> <li>NYC, US </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.</p> <p>As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. title: International Expansion - Netherlands
description: At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France and Europe? Do you thrive in a trustful, fast-paced environment? Then Pennylane might be the right place for you — and you, might be the perfect fit for this role 🙂 Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of European SMEs. We help business owners get rid of the time consuming hassle of handling accounting and finance, while giving them access to key information that they can use to make better decisions. Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and we're accelerating in Germany 🇩🇪) In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! About Strategy & Operations at Pennylane: At Pennylane, being part of the Strategy & Operations team means deeply understanding operational realities. As we launch our German entity, we design and implement efficient, scalable solutions that enable Pennylane to reach and exceed its ambitious expansion targets. Your role will be pivotal in structuring local operations from scratch, scaling existing processes, and tailoring our operating model to the specificities of the German market. To make this launch a success, our Strategy & Operations teams work daily alongside Business teams (Sales, Success Managers), Tech teams (Developers, Product Managers), and Data teams (Data Scientists, Data Analysts). The Goal Significantly boost team productivity through better tool utilization, process simplification, and operational structuring to support the launch and expansion of our German entity. Day-to-Day Impact You will be the owner, key point of contact, and driver of change within the Business Teams for the German market. You will work closely with operational managers leading Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Account Management. Your Role Drive transformation and challenge the status quo: Observe, listen, challenge existing setups, and continuously propose optimizations to reduce time spent on manual admin tasks or data searches. You will pave the way for future local growth, structure operations for a new entity, and document all procedural changes. Implement operational improvements: Roll out solution-driven initiatives through new information systems, app modifications, or organizational changes. You will lead projects while leveraging cross-functional capabilities (Data, Sales, Finance, etc.). Your mission will also be to ensure high customer satisfaction, hit delivery deadlines, and monitor roll-out KPIs. Scale and localize processes: Adapt global operational frameworks to German market specificities while remaining aligned with core Pennylane standards. Benchmark and innovate: Observe other departments, take a step back, run benchmarks, and gather insights to refine operational strategies. Enable teams and drive adoption: Implement strong communication and hands-on support for German teams to ensure smooth onboarding onto new methodologies (optimal tooling, training, continuous improvement). You will ensure daily tool adoption and process adherence. Bridge Ops and Corporate strategy: Gain a high-level view of corporate challenges to anticipate their impact on local German operations and provide operational visibility through data-driven insights. Candidate Profile We are looking for an ambitious professional with a proven track record in organizational transformation, productivity improvement, project management, and operational structuring in a fast-paced environment. Key Qualifications & Skills Languages: Fluent in German and English Minimum of 4 years of proven experience in business transformation and operational efficiency through system and tool implementation. First-hand experience or a strong appetite for market launches, entity structuring, or scaling operations. Strong natural curiosity and drive to make a real impact: active listener and sharp observer. End-to-end project management experience: ability to scope problems quickly, execute fast, and iterate without waiting for perfection. Ability to balance granular detail with a high-level strategic perspective. Strong business acumen. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex issues. Appetite for or knowledge of AI, No-Code tools, and process automation. Strong analytical skills (proficiency in SQL is a plus). Familiarity with SaaS business operations and tools like Salesforce and Intercom is a plus. What do we do to make your work life easier 🏢 This job is based in Berlin with an on-site presence a few days per week at our Berlin office (Rosenthaler Strasse 43–45). 💵 An attractive package (detailed during the screening stage) 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🌴 30 days of paid leave per year. 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🎉 Regular company events: We value spending time together through events such as our Tech Days, held every three months, our annual company offsite, and team gatherings approximately once a month at our Berlin office (Rosenthaler Strasse 43–45). 🤝 Hiring Process: Intro Call: First exchange with Thomas (Recruiter) - 30 min video call Manager Interview: Interview with Alexandre (Chief of Staff Germany) – 45min video call Case Study: Practical exercise with two Pennylane Strategy & Operations Manager – 60min video call On-site fit: With team members from the Sales or Success Departments. Final Round: Interview with Eric Scaramozzino (VP Strategic Initiatives) and Tobias Janiesch (General Manager) - 45min to 1H video call We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply anyway: worst case scenario, you might lose a few minutes, and in the best case, it will be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration. title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
description: We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience. Responsibilities & Tasks Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures. Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies. Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls. Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights. Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk. Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers. Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable. Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures. Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment. Requirements & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience. Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience. Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools. Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage. Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial. Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers. High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility. Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage. Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually. Benefits & Culture Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role. Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas. Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment. title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
description: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it.
