title: DevOps Engineer
description: In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission. At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. Our technology turns disconnected assets into coordinated forces, helping operators make accurate decisions when it matters most. Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, Intelic offers a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics - they meaningfully impact safety, resilience, and the future of Europe's security. Why This Role Exists Nexus has to run in places most software never goes: offline, in the field, installed and operated by people who are not developers. Getting it there in one piece, and keeping it running, is a job on its own. Right now that job sits mostly with three backend engineers who cover this alongside their own work. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards. What You Will Do You will join Product Adoption, the team that owns the last stretch between working software and a field-ready product: deployment, installers, monitoring, and everything that keeps Nexus running once it leaves the building. We are hiring at medior to senior level, roughly a 2 to 3, with room to flex higher for the right person. Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines that turn Nexus into an installable, field-ready product across Linux and Windows Maintain and harden our software supply chain, including dependency scanning and package security Own the Windows installer and service orchestration, and help developers debug the platform-specific issues that come with it: permissions, firewalls, services, "works on my machine" Secure the software update server, the one online touchpoint in an otherwise offline system, and keep telemetry from the field reliable without leaking sensitive data Harden APIs and authentication on the surfaces that face the outside world Maintain and gradually take over our on-prem infrastructure: physical servers, backups, and disaster recovery, as we move away from renting machines in the cloud Build small internal tools, mostly in Python, Rust and shell or PowerShell scripts: installers, updaters, and the occasional internal or customer-facing web app Support incident response when things break in production, and help build the monitoring that catches problems before customers do Write down what you learn, so the next person, including future you, doesn't have to debug the same thing twice You'll Thrive Here If You bring solid experience with CI/CD pipelines and build automation Comfort working across both Linux and Windows, with the ability to actually debug problems on either, not just deploy to them Experience with infrastructure as code (Ansible, OpenTofu, or similar) A security mindset: hardening, secure defaults, and attack surface are just part of how you build things, not an afterthought Enough scripting or programming ability to read and contribute to Python, Rust, or shell scripts. There is there is plenty of custom tooling to build. A level head under pressure. You can prioritise and stay steady when a few things break at once Nice to have: Experience with on-prem, bare-metal or virtulized infrastructure, not just cloud consoles Familiarity with Docker Exposure to dependency and package scanning tools such as Sonatype An interest in platform or infrastructure engineering as its own discipline. We expect this to split into a dedicated function over time Ability to build in-house tooling where needed and integrate vendor solutions where they fit What Your First Year Will Look Like You've taken over meaningful parts of the CI/CD pipeline and installer work independently, without needing step-by-step instructions You've hardened at least one exposed surface end to end, the update server, an API, or similar You've helped move part of our infrastructure off rented machines and onto hardware we run ourselves Developers come to you when something breaks on Windows or Linux, because you've built a track record of finding the actual root cause You've documented enough of what you know that the team is less dependent on any one person, including you Why Intelic We are setting up an environment, largely from the ground up that has to approved by MoDs You won't be bored. New projects, new problems, and a steady stream of things nobody has solved here before Real ownership from day one, not ticket-taking. If you see a better tool or approach, you're free to try it You'll work with hardware that matters: servers you can walk up to, deployments running in places with no internet, problems that cloud-only engineers rarely see A small team that leans on each other. When someone's on leave, the rest pick up the slack, and vice versa The mission is real. Nexus supports operators in the field, and how well you build and secure it has a direct effect on whether it works when it counts What We Offer Stock Appreciation Rights programme (equity) A vibrant office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord — where we come together in person every day, because we believe it matters for the kind of work we do Flexible pension plan 25 vacation days Travel allowance Urban Sports corporate membership Lease a Bike option Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Rust)

The platform is set up, and the team is working at the level you helped set. At 12 months: The platform runs without you in the middle of it, and you're helping on the wider vehicle platform, including the flight side. Why Intelic The mission is real. You shape the APIs and the team instead of maintaining someone else's design. You can focus on engineering. The problem is clear. Your job is to solve it well. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Strategic Pursuits, APAC (Based in Singapore)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4>Available Locations: Singapore</h4> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <p>The Strategic Pursuits Customer Engineer (CE) is a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to Cloudflare’s most important and complex sales pursuits. You will work alongside account teams and senior customer stakeholders to understand each organization’s business priorities, technology landscape, and long-term transformation agenda—and translate them into measurable outcomes with Cloudflare.</p> <p>This role combines deep application modernisation and network security expertise with strong sales pursuit leadership. You will proactively shape large, complex deals, build strategic engagement plans, and connect Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to enterprise-wide initiatives. You will orchestrate the right Cloudflare resources across sales, product, support, services, and leadership, and guide customers from executive discovery and technical validation through decision, architectural handover, value realization, and platform expansion. <br><br><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic pursuit leadership:</strong> Lead technical strategy for large, complex sales pursuits; title: Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™, EMEA
description: <p><strong>Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™</strong></p> <p><strong>Location</strong><strong><br></strong>This is a <strong>fully remote</strong> opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong><br>Become part of the team behind <strong><a href="https://www.doit.com/blog/why-we-are-launching-attribute?_gl=1*j8dlue*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTUwMzU2OTc0NS4xNzgzNDEzMDIx*_ga_Y90QRD61TR*czE3ODM0MTMwMjAkbzEkZzEkdDE3ODM0MTMwMzMkajQ3JGwwJGg2MjkyMjk4OTAkZDN4YlFHcnJpZVVJUzJiV2JORC02QXZmOGtLLWJzczczelE" target="_blank">Attribute™</a></strong>. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.</p> <p>DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for <strong>Attribute™</strong>, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.</p> <p>Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.</p> <p>As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.</p> <p>You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.</p> <p>You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.</p> <p>Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets</li> <li>Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA</li> <li>Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on</li> <li>Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA</li> <li>Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share</li> <li>Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face</li> <li>Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver</li> <li>Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience</li> <li>Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch</li> <li>A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work</li> <li>Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently</li> <li>Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.</li> <li>Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way</li> <li>Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture</li> <li>Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care</li> other projects and ad hoc requests</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Solid experience with Workday configuration within Compensation and Advanced Compensation functional areas.</li> <li>Confidence with Workday Security, Business Processes, Reporting, Calculated Fields, Condition Rules, EIBs, Custom Organization hierarchies.</li> <li>Advanced Excel / Gsheet skills</li> and written English</li> <li>Capability of handling confidential information discreetly and demonstrate a strong work ethic.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. title: Model Risk Officer
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like. AI at Mollie We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: <blockquote>Shape our offensive security services</blockquote> <p>Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? Join our security team at Schuberg Philis! We are an engineering company with a people-centric approach and a focus on customer satisfaction, dedicated to delivering mission critical IT solutions to our customers.<br><br>As an offensive security specialist, you will collaborate with about 30 customer-oriented teams managing critical system environments. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the security of Schuberg Philis and its customers by identifying and exploiting realistic paths in our complex, one-of-a-kind environments. You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We focus on what real-world adversaries search for and abuse, not compliance-driven checks that look good on paper but don't raise resilience.<br><br>You will engage closely with engineers, customer teams, external experts, vendors, and stakeholders to define and drive work that measurably strengthens these environments. The engagements are hands-on and technical, and we want someone who can own an engagement end-to-end: from a customer saying "we want to test something, can you help us figure out what?" all the way to presenting the results of a bespoke engagement to their board.<br><br>At Schuberg Philis, we thrive on growth and innovation, offering an exciting environment for security enthusiasts. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued.</p> <p>We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis. <br><br>In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role.</li> <li>A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective.</li> <li>Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Recommendations should fit the environment in front of you, not a textbook fix that can't be applied there.</li> <li>You will have the experience and judgment to run engagements on your own, and the collaborative instinct to tackle the hardest problems together. Our teams will love you if you can take them by the hand through the entire process.</li> <li>Experience and understanding at least one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li> <li>Strong risk management thinking, sense of ownership, and a solid BS radar.</li> <li>Eagerness to learn, coupled with a stubborn determination to make things happen.</li> <li>Experience with building solid tools that support our activities.</li> <li>Experience in IT engineering and IT engineering heavy environments preferred.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What will be your focus?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help scope, lead, execute, and report on various types of complex offensive security engagements. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well.</li> <li>Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams.</li> <li>Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics.</li> <li>Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements.</li> <li>Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Where we would love to grow as a team</strong><br>We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. title: Senior Software Engineer - ZTC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin</strong></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.<br>As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.</p> <p>You can read more about what we work on here:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/</a></li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Rust</li> <li>Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking</li> <li>Systems-level programming experience in Linux</li> <li>Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems</li> <li>Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems</li> <li>Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process</li> <li>Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions</li> <li>Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver</li> <li>Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication</li> <li>Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets. Build the measurement Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision. Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's. Build and lead the team Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour. WHAT YOU BRING Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale. Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses. Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself. A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals. Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel. Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work. Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach. English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred. WHAT WE OFFER Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India. Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it. Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem. Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager
description: We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow. ABOUT THE ROLE You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow. You can still carry an architecture discussion and review a design, and your team would trust your judgement on it A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've run or driven product discovery, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results You set the bar for AI adoption on your team. You use it to real effect in your own work, you're honest about where it helped and where it fell short, and you're the first to try new tools, bringing the ones that stick to your engineers. Nice to have You are eager to scale your experience beyond your team - to create wider organisational impact Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets Experience with TypeScript and AWS Our stack TypeScript across the board, running on AWS with infrastructure as code, in a single monorepo. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. You design for manufacturing, assembly, quality, cost and serviceability, and you settle tolerances, interfaces and process constraints early. Work hand in hand with suppliers. You partner with sourcing on technical feasibility, tooling and part iterations. Own qualification. You qualify parts with the intended production materials and processes, and you agree product-specific acceptance criteria with the test engineers. Deliver the production-ready product file. CAD, 2D drawings, tolerances, BOMs, material and process specifications and acceptance criteria. Hand over a running line. Once the qualification gates have passed and ramp-up is complete, you hand the line and the product file to Production and Production Engineering. Requirements You have several years of experience taking mechanical products through the full lifecycle: prototype, series production and quality monitoring at the customer. Ideally on structurally critical products at volumes of hundreds to a few thousand units. You are strong in CAD (Solidworks/PDM preferred), tolerance analysis and material selection. You have practical experience with injection molding as well as additive manufacturing for functional plastic parts. You prototype fast and pragmatically, then qualify and document with discipline. You like hands-on work: builds, testing and working with suppliers. You use AI for design exploration, qualification planning and data analysis. You check its output, share new workflows and keep raising the team’s bar. You are curious, flexible and collaborative, with a real drive to build the next great thing. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. description: About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. About The Role About the role We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is. What You'll Do What you'll do Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones. Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs. Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows. Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules. Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop. What You Bring What you bring Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review. Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend. BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar. Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience. Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked. Nice To Have Nice to have Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid. Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide. Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus. Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases. Work in the EU Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes. </p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.</li> <li>Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.</li> <li>Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.</li> <li>Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.</li> <li>Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.</li> <li>Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.</li> <li>Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.</li> <li>You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.</li> <li>You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.</li> <li>You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services. </li> <li>You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.</li> <li>You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.</li> <li>You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.</li> <li>You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities</li> <li>You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Data stores</li> <li>Search, analytics, Lucene</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the JDK</li> <li>Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Head of Insurance Supply
description: 🍇 About grape: Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first. At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business. Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team. What you’ll do: 1. Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year. Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk. 2. Build strong carrier partnerships Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level. Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations. Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels. Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time. Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market. 3. Shape products and build the function Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products. Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications. Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution. Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting. Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk. Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows. What you’ll bring: At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier. A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement. Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers. A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications. Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market. The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail. Fluent English. Strong advantage: Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures. Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z. Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment. German or French proficiency. Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function. If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you. 🤝 What we offer in return: 🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions. 💻 Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office. 🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home. 🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office. ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to. 🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually ❤️‍🩹 Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy. 🎫 Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams. ✈️ Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues. 🚂 Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office. 🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days. 🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs. 👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life. ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review). 🏁 Our recruitment process We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps: Step 1 - Your motivation To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team. Step 2 - Role fit In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager. Step 3 - Case study For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. description: This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations. If you've built something before, start here The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. What you'll do You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with. Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved. Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on. Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate. Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix. Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people. What success looks like after 3 months There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls You make things simpler over time, not more clever You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit Ambiguity and chaos bother you You want a well-defined backlog handed to you Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount Our stack Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one. How we hire Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions. Technical deep-dive call : walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong. Meet Scalera Day : join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team. Offer : if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer. Working at Scalera Remote within the EU or EEA Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success Competitive compensation Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. If you've built something before, start here Most ML jobs hand you a benchmark. This one hands you a business problem with paying customers and their real data. Construction tenders are long, messy and full of trade jargon, and every decision a customer makes on our platform becomes a labeled example you can train on. We need someone who can turn that data into models that customers notice: from the first experiment to the model serving production traffic, and back again when a customer says it got something wrong. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first ML engineer somewhere, or shipped a model people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Manufacturers, wholesalers and suppliers in Switzerland, Austria and Germany still run their most document-heavy work by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate that work one process at a time, and ML sits at the center of every one of them. What you'll own You'll own the ML behind our products, end to end. In practice that means: Training and fine-tuning : embedding models, rerankers, classifiers and LLMs, trained on our own data. Document understanding : models that pull structure, quantities and product specs out of tenders, orders and catalogs. Product matching : retrieval and LLM agents that match tender positions to the right products. Evaluation : offline benchmarks, per-customer evals and gates that keep a new model from shipping if it makes things worse. Training and serving infrastructure : automated retrain pipelines, GPU serving and vector search in production. Customer problems : when a model gets something wrong for a customer, finding out why and fixing it. What success looks like after 3 months There's a model or part of the pipeline people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next. You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version. A model you trained runs in production, and customers can see the difference in their results. Retraining runs automatically, and nothing reaches customers without passing an eval you designed. You've cut LLM cost or latency by replacing an expensive step with a smaller model of your own. You've decided at least one thing we should stop building. You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a model in production, or a side project with real users. You've trained and fine-tuned models yourself, ideally embeddings, retrieval or document models, and evaluated them honestly on held-out data. You've built with LLMs in production and know where agents fail. You write strong Python and can run what you build: Docker, CI/CD, and cloud on GCP, AWS or Azure. You measure before you believe, and a single aggregate score doesn't convince you. You'd rather open a customer's actual document than wait for a spec. You're comfortable with ambiguity. You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement. You probably won't enjoy it if You just want to code and go home. You don't like talking to customers. Ambiguity and chaos bother you. You want a well-defined research agenda handed to you. You'd rather hand a model to someone else to deploy and debug. Your main goal is managing people soon. title: Senior Account Executive, SLED (NJ/PA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New Jersey or Pennsylvania</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The ideal candidate will possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at all levels with technical and non-technical buyers.</li> <li>As an Senior SLED Account Executive, you'll be responsible for developing and executing against a comprehensive account/territory plan as well as driving sales in a defined territory and/or account list to achieve revenue targets. The person in this role will also assist in creating and articulating compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services.</li> <li>Manage contract negotiations</li> <li>Maintain a robust sales pipeline</li> <li>Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience selling technical solutions or products to the Public Sector (SLED, Federal Government, Municipalities, etc.)</li> <li>Experience managing longer, complex sales cycles`</li> <li>Basic understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</li> <li>Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science, or MIS a plus)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.</li> <li>Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment</li> <li>Experience selling to SLED customer base</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New Jersey based hires: Estimated annual salary of $269,000-$370,000</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. title: Chief Marketing Officer, Factor Europe
description: <h2><strong>About Factor</strong></h2> <p>Factor is the #1 ready-to-eat brand for people who see personal health as a key ingredient to achieving their goals. Developed by chefs and dietitians, Factor makes healthy eating effortless, enjoyable, and full of flavor. Part of the HelloFresh Group, Factor is the fastest-growing business in the group, and we are now building the next chapter in Europe.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a senior marketing leader to own Factor's European growth. You will run the full marketing agenda across multiple markets: acquiring new customers efficiently, owning the P&L across countries, and building the partnerships and channels that will take Factor beyond direct-to-consumer. This is a lean, flat team that moves fast. You will have full accountability for European decisions, and you will work directly with the leadership team to shape where the business goes next.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul>
