partnerships network.</strong> Expand our rolodex of influencers and strategic partners that feed the acquisition engine.</li> <li><strong>Lead creative with a clear point of view.</strong> Oversee creative functions and set a direction for how Factor shows up for customers.</li> <li><strong>Partner with finance.</strong> Work with finance on business planning, forecasting, and end-to-end customer retention.</li> <li><strong>Prepare new growth channels.</strong> Build toward new distribution channels such as retail and B2B over the next 12 to 18 months, establishing revenue lines beyond direct-to-consumer.</li> <li><strong>Build and lead a lean, high-performing team.</strong> Create clear accountability and keep the organization flat, adding capacity only where the opportunity is clear.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Senior marketing leadership at a scaled European subscription or e-commerce brand</strong>, with a track record of growing new customer volume at efficient acquisition costs.</li> <li><strong>P&L ownership across several countries.</strong> You have been accountable for results, not only for marketing activity.</li> <li><strong>General management experience.</strong> This can come from business, strategy, or consulting roles, or from end-to-end management, including at a smaller company.</li> are not only a manager of managers. title: Mid Market Account Executive - Benelux
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong><br><br>Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. We are seeking account managers to oversee deal sizes ranging from €10k to €300k across a comprehensive suite of 15+ product solutions, engaging key decision-makers including Finance Directors and Managing Directors. Joining our team offers the autonomy and support to tackle challenging objectives and drive impactful results.</p> <p>While this position offers remote flexibility across the Netherlands, periodic travel to meet clients on-site is expected (typically bi-weekly).</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You want to help define the future of physical operations: Your contributions will directly enable real-world impact—supporting critical infrastructure, streamlining supply chains, and advancing workforce safety.</li> <li>You prioritize continuous prospecting: Physical operations encompass wide-ranging sectors where contacts are often mobile. Top sales reps actively identify prospective organizations and build meaningful pipeline connection points.</li> <li>You possess deep curiosity about diverse business models: You will explore various physical sectors, from field services to manufacturing and food distribution, striving to understand operational details at scale.</li> <li>You are committed to continuous learning: Navigating our cloud platform involves mastering new operational domains and solutions, requiring dedicated focus to achieve long-term growth.</li> <li>You foster authentic long-term partnerships: Many target organizations are transitioning from legacy methods to modern cloud technology. Earning long-term trust is core to helping them digitally transform.</li> <li>You thrive on high-performing teams: Working at Samsara means being part of a team dedicated to excellence and pushing boundaries as we build for the future.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.</li> <li>Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.</li> <li>Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.</li> <li>Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.</li> <li>Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.</li> <li>Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Advantageous:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.</li> <li>Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.</li> <li>Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.</li> <li>Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.</span></p></div><div class="title">Annual OTE Salary</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€132.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€132.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. targets</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and articulate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manage contract negotiations</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maintain a robust sales pipeline</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensure customer satisfaction</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Develop and maintain partner relationships as it relates to customer base</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Minimum 5 years of direct technical sales experience </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience selling solutions related to Cyber Security, Networking, Cloud Solutions, SaaS, IaaS, PaaS is a plus  </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mid to advanced understanding of computer networking and “how the internet works”</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Aptitude for learning complex technical concepts/terms (technical background in engineering, computer science, or IT strongly desired)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable working in a fast paced, dynamic environment</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either. Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC. Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app. Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage. Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite. A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove. The first 90 days Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads. Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week. What this role is not Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions. Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed. Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed. Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached. Other requirements A dedicated workspace. A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. Why work for Xapo? Impact Globally, Work Remotely. Shape the Future Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world. Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals. At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and eth

title: Associate (PE, Buy & Build) (m/w/d)
description: TW1 ist ein dynamisches Schweizer Beteiligungsunternehmen mit einem Family-Office an Board und einer klaren Wachstumsstrategie, das sich auf die nachhaltige Übernahme und Weiterführung von Familienunternehmen im Bereich Hauswartungen spezialisiert hat. Mit mehreren Standorten und einem engagierten Team treiben wir nachhaltiges Wachstum durch strategische Übernahmen und gezielte Zusammenarbeit voran. Durch den Einsatz moderner Digitalisierung schaffen wir Synergien und steigern den Wert der Unternehmen, mit denen wir kooperieren. Du steigst in eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe ein mit echter Machermentalität und übernimmst von Tag eins strategische Verantwortung. Aufgaben Als Associate arbeitest du direkt an der Schnittstelle von Strategie und Umsetzung und unterstützt die Integration neuer Akquisitionen sowie die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Beteiligungen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern (Ex-BCG) und den Portfolio-Geschäftsführern packst du dort an, wo bei uns wirklich etwas bewegt wird. PMI & Value Creation: Du arbeitest an spannenden Post-Merger-Integration-Themen mit - von der Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung des 100-Day-Plans bis hin zur Entwicklung von Automatisierungsprozessen, die unsere Portfoliounternehmen effizienter und skalierbarer machen. Operational Excellence: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Initiativen zur Effizienzsteigerung, Prozessoptimierung und Skalierung der Geschäftsmodelle über das gesamte Portfolio hinweg. Performance & Governance: Du hilfst beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Steuerungsmechanismen für eine transparente Performance-Messung und lieferst datenbasierte Grundlagen für strategische Entscheidungen. Operations Support: Du begleitest die Portfoliounternehmen aktiv bei der Optimierung gruppenweiter Schlüsselprozesse, Systeme und Strukturen, um Synergien und Best Practices zu realisieren. Growth & Analyse: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Wachstumshebeln und der Aufbereitung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf Gruppen- und Beteiligungsebene. Qualifikation 2–3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Corporate Development, PE, Consulting (MBB) oder Big Four bzw. einer vergleichbaren fast-paced Rolle. Solides Verständnis von Geschäftsmodellen, operativen Prozessen und Unternehmensstrategie - idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Umfeld von Wachstums- oder KMU-Unternehmen. Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit Fokus auf Umsetzung, Ergebnisorientierung und hoher Eigenverantwortung. Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und ein sicherer Umgang mit Excel/Daten sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsthemen. Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (fliessend) und Englisch, Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil. Lust, in einem dynamischen Umfeld schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen, und Offenheit für Change im KMU-Kontext. Benefits Bei uns übernimmst du früh Verantwortung und arbeitest von Tag eins an realen PMI- und Value-Creation-Themen mit sichtbarem Impact. Du arbeitest in einem High-Pace-Environment mit steiler Lernkurve, flachen Hierarchien und direktem Zugang zu erfahrenen Ex-Beratern. Wir bieten ein kompetitives Vergütungspaket inklusive leistungsbezogenem Bonussystem sowie der Möglichkeit, sich am langfristigen Erfolg der Gruppe zu beteiligen. Wenn du unternehmerisch denkst, ehrgeizig bist und in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, in dem wirklich etwas abgeht, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Bitte reiche deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV, Zeugnisse oder GPA sowie relevante Referenzschreiben) ein. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Storytelling and narrative lead
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are looking for an outstanding <strong>storytelling and narrative development lead</strong> to lead our content marketing team. Canonical has a robust portfolio of open source products and offers support for a wide range of open source technologies. This role is for someone who cares deeply about narrative quality and wants to elevate our brand positioning. It requires process discipline and creative smarts, leadership skills and performance-driven strategy to ensure our content aligns with our business objectives. </p> <p>The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, technology marketing and the use of technology in marketing. They would love to gain experience optimizing content processes, coaching others on their narrative skills and building brand authority. They enjoy learning and improving themselves, the team and the organization. They problem solve, get hands-on, experiment, measure and use automation to make daily life easier. To succeed in this role, the candidate must be metrics-driven, highly organized and skilled at team development, capacity planning and cross-functional collaboration.  </p> <p>This role reports to the Director of Communications. </p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home based in the EMEA region. </p> <h2>What your day will look like</h2> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with our business goals, SEO and brand. </li> <li>Manage our content calendar end to end, ensuring content is efficiently produced with minimum friction and process clarity.</li> <li>Ensure content quality, consistency and brand alignment in everything we produce. </li> <li>Collaborate with our web and growth engineering teams to optimize content for search and AI engines, building on proven SEO or GEO expertise. </li> <li>Supervise quarterly content planning sessions and work closely with content specialists, product management and marketing to optimize content plans.</li> <li>Monitor and report on KPIs for our content program and use analytics tools to identify improvement opportunities. </li> <li>Align messaging to ensure integrated campaign support across channels, working closely with our marketing, product and brand teams.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of work experience in content or related roles, preferably at technology companies, with 2+ years of experience as a manager or team lead. </li> <li>Proven experience creating authoritative and engaging content. Portfolio of written work required.</li> <li>Applied knowledge of GEO and SEO, experience with relevant tools and SEO-driven content calendars. </li> <li>Excellent project management and interpersonal skills with the ability to create highly efficient processes for content production and reuse. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications or a relevant discipline. </li> <li>Someone who is passionate about technology and open source. </li> <li>A problem solver: you don’t shy away from taking on challenges and see projects through to completion. </li> <li>Attention to detail and appreciation for standards: you value quality and accuracy but can adapt quickly when the need arises.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  <br>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.</p> <p>🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</p> <p>📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum</p> <p>💰Annual compensation review</p> <p>🏆Recognition rewards</p> <p>🏝 Annual holiday leave</p> <p>👶Parental Leave</p> <p>🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme</p> <p>🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</p> <h2><strong>About Canonical</strong></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Remote within: US, Canada, UK, Portugal<br><br>About the role</h3> <p>New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.</p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 20% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.</p> <h1>Responsibilities</h1> <h2>Product strategy and roadmap</h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.</li> <li>Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.</li> <li>Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.</li> <li>Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.</li> <li>Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.</li> <li>Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.</li> <li>Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Customer experience</h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation</li> <li>Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.</li> <li>Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>Operations and communications</h2> <ul> <li>Support the Cloudflare Security Research team’s vulnerability-response work by providing product context and customer perspective</li> <li>Coordinate responsible disclosure and external vulnerability communications with Security, Legal, and Communications</li> <li>Write technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities</li> </ul> <h2>Skills Required </h2> <ul> <li>Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.</li> <li>Ability to synthesize input from security research, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.</li> <li>Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.</li> <li>Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.</li> <li>An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Lisbon </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of 65,000 - 80,000 EURO</li> <li>For <strong>New York City </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $216,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

On an average day, you might pitch a concept to senior leadership, collaborate with marketing, work with designers to conduct user research, prototype a new feature, iterate on a spec, analyze usage data, and pair with an engineer on implementation.</p> <p>We are seeking a strategic and technical Senior Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and evolution of our Threat Intelligence portfolio. Your mission is to ensure Cloudflare’s security products and customers can identify, understand, and respond to emerging threats earlier and with greater confidence. You will own the end-to-end roadmap for the platforms, data, and workflows that transform Cloudflare’s unique network signals and security research into timely, actionable intelligence, balancing speed and coverage with accuracy, context, and low false-positive rates.</p> <p>You will translate a rapidly evolving threat landscape, from emerging attacker infrastructure and campaigns to new tactics, techniques, and procedures, into scalable capabilities that improve detection and response across Cloudflare’s security portfolio. You will serve as a bridge between threat researchers, intelligence analysts, engineering teams, and market-facing functions, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, and our customers to understand their challenges and drive adoption. Your success will be measured by the quality, timeliness, and actionability of our intelligence and its impact on customer security outcomes.</p> <h3><strong>You will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own your space. You will own the priorities and scope for a high performing engineering team focusing on detecting advanced threat actors. </li> <li>Connect the pieces. You should be comfortable working with data, and analyzing data to quantify the impact of problems and opportunities in your space. </li> </ul> <h3>Key qualifications and skills</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a product manager delivering solutions in the cloud at scale for a technical audience </li> <li>Customer focus. At Cloudflare, we serve the needs of customers large and small, and our product managers need to be comfortable understanding how to design for enterprises without compromising the experience for individuals and small businesses. </li> <li><strong>AI Fluency: </strong>Demonstrated experience using AI assistants, coding tools, and agentic workflows to accelerate product work. This includes delivering product updates to executive stakeholders (both internal and external), maintaining proactive communication during incidents, setting clear and realistic expectations, and driving cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Technical Acumen. You must have the ability to grasp complex technical concepts and be able to effectively translate these complex ideas for customers through various channels, including calls, blog posts, and reports. You must be comfortable engaging in deep technical discussions with engineering teams.</li> <li>Preferred: candidate with professional experience in threat intelligence, adversary tactics and common TI frameworks, and/or general intelligence requirements and prioritization concepts.</li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong><br>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Als Senior AI Engineer combineer je diepgang in machine learning en MLOps met diepgang in generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bent erbij vanaf het eerste klantgesprek en bent als delivery lead eindverantwoordelijk voor de oplevering. Wat ga je doen? Nieuwe projecten opzetten: van eerste gesprek tot proposal, met steun van sales. Je inspireert de klant vanuit de inhoud, bedenkt de oplossing en zet een degelijke projectplanning neer. De oplevering leiden: als delivery lead doe je het projectmanagement, geef je dagelijks leiding aan de uitvoering en voer je het stakeholdermanagement. Technische keuzes maken en meebouwen: je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen en bouwt zelf mee. Met een FDE in het team werk je het agentic ontwerp samen uit. Naar productie en draaiend houden: MLOps, monitoring, security en onderhoudbaarheid zijn bij jou geen bijzaak. Het team optillen: je begeleidt collega's en helpt standaarden te ontwikkelen. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Wat breng je mee? Diepgang in ML engineering en MLOps én in GenAI, LLM's en agents, met oplossingen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden. Je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen, met oog voor evals, monitoring, security en de EU AI Act. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Ervaring met business development én als delivery lead of projectleider. Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling. Wat ga je doen? In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren. Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust. De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW) Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare. Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen. Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken. In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses. In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer. Als teamleider … Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig. Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders. Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team. Als R&D Engineer… Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten. In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls. Verantwoordelijkheden Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW; Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken; Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt; Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren; Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica); Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie; Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau); Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden; In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht. Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of . Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. De teamleider is een parttime functie. Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! title: Engineering Manager, Stablecoins
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London or Austin or SF or NYC</strong></p> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering high-volume, low-value machine-to-machine transactions using blockchain technologies and decentralized protocols. Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web <strong>payable</strong> at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web <strong>payable</strong>.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our stablecoin initiatives.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power decentralized agent transactions, such as Cloudflare’s stablecoin wallets and emerging micropayment rails that make web resources <strong>payable</strong>. You will partner closely with Product Management, cryptography experts, and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible in distributed systems, smart contracts, and cryptographic protocols. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around blockchains (including transactions, RPCs, and execution + consensus clients)  and step in when necessary.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across blockchain architecture, stablecoin wallets, and cryptographic payment channels to ensure the web remains <strong>payable</strong> for autonomous agents.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of a high-throughput blockchain leveraging cryptocurrency protocols and standards to enable ultra-low-latency micropayments.</li> <li>Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience building L1 or L2 blockchains is a plus.</li> <li>Experience building or operating cryptocurrency infrastructure, digital wallet providers, or decentralized settlement protocols. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).</li> <li>Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.</li> <li>Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $288,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $275,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan&l

Dein Profil Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung EFZ/HF/FH oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung im System-, Cloud- oder Security Engineering und bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in SecOps, SOC/MDR, Incident Response oder Security Engineering mit, idealerweise im MSP- oder Kundenumfeld. Security Operations: Du bist erfahren in Incident Response, EDR/XDR, Vulnerability Management sowie in der strukturierten Fallbearbeitung und sauberen Ticketdokumentation. Scripting & Automatisierung: Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben mit PowerShell. Kenntnisse in Python, der Microsoft Graph API sowie in Logic Apps und SIEM-/SOAR-Lösungen sind von Vorteil. Ganzheitliches Systemverständnis: Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Identitäten, Endpoints, Netzwerken, Cloud, Backup, Applikationen und Betriebsprozessen und behältst auch in komplexen Umgebungen den Überblick.
