title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. title: Senior Product Manager, Signals & Data Products
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, London, or San Francisco (Hybrid)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Search engines spent two decades learning what the web is worth: which pages are fresh, which sources are trusted, what people actually use. That knowledge came from watching how humans moved through the web.</p> <p>Agents break that loop. AI models are trained and grounded on the web, but they have little visibility into what's changed, what's authoritative, or what's been fabricated. Site owners have it worse: AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back, and most have no idea how, or whether, they show up in AI answers. Both sides of the market are flying blind.</p> <p>Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. Signals & Data Products turns our network's view into products both sides can use: helping AI labs know what's fresh and trustworthy, and helping site owners see and shape how they show up in AI. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen! You can read more about some of our plans <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">here</a> and <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/agentic-web/">here</a>. </p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the strategy for Signals, our web intelligence feed, and shape where our data products go next</li> <li>Define what makes a signal worth paying for (freshness, provenance, trust, real-world usage) using data from Cloudflare's network</li> <li>Build for both sides of the market: data products for AI labs, and visibility for site owners into how AI models find, use, and cite them</li> <li>Explore what comes next, from knowledge graphs to measuring how sites show up in AI answers</li> <li>Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches</li> <li>Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity</li> <li>Work with Partnerships and BD on data partnerships with AI labs and other large buyers</li> <li>Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years as a technical PM, with experience shipping data, search, ranking, or ML products</li> <li>Deep data fluency: you can reason about data quality, coverage, bias, and pipelines</li> <li>Experience building or selling data products or APIs (licensing, pricing, enterprise contracts) is a strong plus</li> <li>A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer 'show' over 'tell'</li> <li>A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity</li> <li>Team oriented: you'd rather get it right than be right</li> </ul> <p><strong>How we work</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/en-gb/careers/">Careers page</a>.</p> <p><strong>Why this role</strong></p> <p>You'll be building a new product category from a vantage point no one else has, on a fast-moving team breaking new ground. You can read about our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-openai-discovery-agentic-web/">early research here</a>. </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $224,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job.

title: Unity Intern
description: Join Our Team as a Unity Developer Intern at Beyond Sports! Hi, I’m Leon, part of the team here at Beyond Sports, and I’d love to invite you to consider joining us as a Unity Developer Intern! Beyond Sports is a visualization company that is changing the way the world experiences sports. We work with the biggest leagues and broadcasters in the world—including the NFL, NHL, NBA and more—to turn real match data into groundbreaking, real-time virtual experiences. From creating the Inside Out Classic altcast with Disney Pixar to building live virtual worlds for fans, our work is at the forefront of sports technology. As part of Sony’s sports businesses, we’re a passionate, creative, and ambitious team based in Alkmaar—and we’re looking for the next generation of talent to join us. If you’re passionate about Unity, real-time 3D, and want to see your work come to life on a global stage, this could be the perfect internship for you. What Your Day Will Look Like As a Unity Developer Intern, you’ll be a real part of the development team. You won’t be observing from the sidelines—you’ll actively contribute to projects that are experienced by millions of sports fans around the world. Working closely with developers, artists, and producers, you’ll help bring data-driven sports experiences to life. Your responsibilities will include: Developing, testing, and debugging real-time 3D applications using Unity and C# Writing clean, efficient, and well-structured code together with the team Assisting with integrating new features, from data processing to visual output Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews Collaborating with experienced developers and learning from their expertise Contributing your own ideas to solve technical challenges and improve our products What We Value At Beyond Sports, we value curiosity, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll thrive in this role if you: Are eager to learn and continuously improve your technical skills Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking analytically Take initiative and feel ownership over your work Have a strong eye for detail Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a team environment About You Currently enrolled in (or recently graduated from) a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field Experience with Unity (Unity3D) and C# Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles Familiar with version control systems, preferably Git Good communication skills in English Available to work on-site in our Alkmaar office Nice to have: Affinity with sports (e.g. football, American football, ice hockey) Experience with Agile/Scrum Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines Why Start Your Career at Beyond Sports You’ll be part of an international and energetic team where no day is the same. We work on cutting-edge technology, move fast, and make sure there’s always room for fun alongside hard work. We also make sure it’s a great place to grow: Daily lunch prepared by our in-house chef Fresh fruit, snacks, and beverages Friday drinks and regular team outings A social and international work environment The opportunity to work on products seen by millions worldwide A chance to learn from experienced developers in a fast-growing tech company Ready to Change the Game? If you’re excited to combine your passion for technology and sports, we’d love to hear from you. At Beyond Sports, you won’t just be learning—you’ll be building the future of sports experiences. title: Data Center Warehouse Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>JDC Warehouse Specialist<br>Position Overview<br>The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.<br>The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.<br>Key Responsibilities<br>1. Receiving & Dispatch<br>•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.<br>•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.<br>•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.<br>•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.<br>2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations<br>•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.<br>•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.<br>•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.<br>3. Inventory & Asset Control<br>•    Post receipts, issues and transfers in ERP/WMS on the same day as the physical movement.<br>•    Create inventory and asset records for received equipment, including serial numbers.<br>•    Carry out cycle counts and annual stock takes; investigate and report discrepancies to Back Office.<br>•    Keep the warehouse tidy, labelled and organized by location.<br>4. Security, Safety & Compliance<br>•    Follow site security procedures for deliveries, access control and storage of high-value items.<br>•    Apply safety rules for handling equipment and operating material handling equipment.<br>•    Keep records complete and audit-ready (SOX, internal and external audits).<br>5. Process & Continuous Improvement<br>•    Work according to global SOPs and site-specific instructions.<br>•    Suggest improvements and report recurring issues to the Team Lead and the Project Office.<br>•    Take part in pilots and rollouts of new processes and tools (WMS/TMS, automations) at the site.<br>6. Local Expertise<br>•    Provide site-specific knowledge (access rules, dock limits, local carriers and customs specifics) to Transport, Planning and 3PL teams.<br>•    Identify local operational risks and propose practical mitigation.<br>7. Add-on Roles (when assigned)<br>•    + RMA: own RMA flows at the site — intake, documentation, return shipment, status tracking.<br>•    + Key User (IRG / NetSuite / Project44): first-line support and training for colleagues on the system, test changes, collect feedback for the Project Office.<br>Expectations<br>Autonomy: Independently runs daily warehouse tasks at the site within SOPs; escalates discrepancies, damage and security issues to the Team Lead.<br>Impact: Keeps DC engineers supplied with the right hardware on time and keeps site stock accurate.<br>Communication: Clear, timely updates to the Team Lead, DC engineers and logistics teams.<br>Travel: Occasional support to other sites during launches or peaks.<br>Work Mode: On site; remote work not expected.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. title: Stage Finance & Control

title: Senior Presales Customer Engineer (based in Canberra)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Canberra</strong>, <strong>Australia</strong></p> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a>&l

title: Workforce & Business Analyst
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope. This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support. You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success. What you'll ship Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget. Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations. Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence. Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend. Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle. What you'll bring 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field. You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight. Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained. Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar). You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it. You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. title: Tech Lead (C# .NET - SaaS & Low-Code), €5.500 - €7.000 | Zoetermeer
description: Ben jij een ervaren ontwikkelaar en leider die graag de technische richting bepaalt én zelf aan de knoppen zit? Als Tech Lead bouw jij samen met het team van ontwikkelaars aan schaalbare cloudoplossingen waarmee dagelijks honderden organisaties slimmer en efficiënter werken. Jij bent een technisch zwaargewicht die de kwaliteit, performance en toekomstbestendigheid van onze moderne SaaS-architectuur bewaakt. Je gaat over de technische beslissingen rondom ons eigen low-code platform en bent dé kartrekker van de groep. Jouw keuzes hebben directe impact op techniek, product én de toekomst van digitale documentverwerking. Jij maakt het mogelijk Onze groei vraagt om robuuste, veilige en altijd beschikbare services. Als Tech Lead merk je direct waar risico’s ontstaan: complexiteit loopt op, schaalbaarheid komt in gevaar en technische schuld vraagt om leiderschap. Jij stuurt bij vóórdat klanten het merken. Met moderne cloud-technologie, duurzame oplossingen en hoge codekwaliteit maak jij samen met het team het verschil, niet alleen vandaag, maar juist voor de toekomst. Je kijkt verder vooruit dan de volgende release en je durft jezelf en het team uit te dagen. Daarnaast coach je de ontwikkelaars uit het team technisch en neem je initiatief om onze producten verder te brengen. Je bent de kartrekker van de groep, en schakelt laagdrempelig met onze product owners, engineering manager en andere development teams. Concreet betekent dit dat jij: + Leiding neemt over het low-code platform ontwikkelteam; + Samen met dit team ontwikkelt aan ons low-code platform, op basis van wensen vanuit de operatie én technische eisen voor future-proofing; + Als senior de codekwaliteit verhoogt door coaching, code-reviews en kennisdeling; + Actief meebouwt aan architectuurkeuzes, coding standards en automatisering in uitrol; + Kwaliteit borgt via tests, monitoring en goede documentatie; + Continu zoekt naar verbeteringen m.b.t. schaalbaarheid, stabiliteit, performance, security; + Samen met collega’s zoals ontwikkelaars, product owners en engineering managers spart over oplossingsrichtingen; + Wanneer nodig onze collega’s van consultancy en support helpt om complexe problemen met ons low-code platform op te lossen; + Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht. Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking. "Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer). Jij hebt het + Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol; + Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen; + Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s; + Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen; + Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau; + Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen; + Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré; + Ervaring met low-code is een pré. Ook breng je mee: + Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security; + Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team; + Eigenaarschap: je houdt overzicht, anticipeert op risico’s en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat; + Een proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief, en zorgt ervoor dat benodigde informatie actief opgehaald wordt zodat projecten vlot doorlopen. Onze Whitevision manier van werken is met respect, daadkracht, betrokkenheid en ambitie. Deze kernwaarden passen dan ook uitstekend bij jouw persoonlijkheid. Dit verdien jij + Een salaris waar je blij van wordt, €5.500 - €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en flexibele werktijden. + Een mooi kantoor in Zoetermeer. We bieden ook de mogelijkheid om ook twee dagen per week thuis te werken, maar veel van onze collega’s vinden het zo leuk om op kantoor te werken dat zij dit minimaal doen. + Wij investeren graag in de groei en ontwikkeling van onze collega’s door middel van training of opleiding. + Een gezellig team met kantoren in Zoetermeer, de Goorn, Rotterdam en Breda. We werken hard, maar lachen minstens zo veel met elkaar! + Onderdeel worden van een snelgroeiend SaaS-bedrijf in Breda met de missie om repeterend werk de wereld uit te helpen. Solliciteer direct! Heb jij zin om je tanden te zetten in uitdagende technische projecten én onze software en processen naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Solliciteer dan nu en wie weet ben jij binnenkort onderdeel van het Whitevision team! Wil je meer informatie over deze vacature? Neem dan contact met ons op via 076-560 7820. (Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Implementatie Consultant SaaS, €4.250 – €6.000 | Breda
description: Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je. Jouw rol Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang. Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn: + Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten. + Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen. + Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau. + Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software. + Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten. + Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis. Wat breng je mee? + Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie. + Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties. + Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement. + Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels). + Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust. + Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré. + Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen. + Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur). Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren. Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken. Wat bieden wij? Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou: + Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring. + Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling. + 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur). + Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden. + Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie. + Een professioneel en hardwerkend team, waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan. + Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf Over Whitevision Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen. Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig. Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen. Doorgroeimogelijkheden Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie. title: Stage Public Affairs Burson Nederland
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Stage Public Affairs bij Burson</strong></p> <p><strong>Wil jij ervaring opdoen op het snijvlak van politiek, media, bestuur en bedrijfsleven?</strong></p> <p>Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Met ons ervaren team van specialisten opereren we op hoog strategisch niveau en helpen we bedrijven en organisaties door de meest complexe situaties: van het versterken of beschermen van reputaties tot het inspelen op veranderende wetgeving, het agenderen van politieke thema’s, het begeleiden van fusies en overnames, productintroducties of crisiscommunicatie. We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.</p> <p>Public Affairs bij Burson is veel meer dan lobbyen op het Binnenhof. In de huidige mediacratie wordt beleid steeds vaker beïnvloed door publieke opinie en politieke sentimenten. Hierdoor verschuift de macht: niet alleen overheid en markt bepalen de agenda, maar ook de samenleving zelf.  Onze adviseurs helpen organisaties om in te spelen op deze dynamiek: maatschappelijke trends signaleren, draagvlak creëren bij uiteenlopende stakeholders, en strategieën ontwikkelen die zowel politiek als publiek overtuigen.</p> <p>Als geïntegreerd communicatieadviesbureau weten wij hoe we Public Affairs versterken met slimme PR en gerichte communicatie, zodat we de juiste doelgroep bereiken, op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, met de juiste boodschap. Daardoor richten ons op het beïnvloeden van relevante stakeholders via een breed scala aan kanalen.</p> <p>Burson stelt jaarlijks per 1 februari en 1 september een Public Affairs stage beschikbaar aan een talentvolle student.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je doen?</strong></p> <p>Als stagiair Public Affairs werk je mee aan diverse projecten en ondersteun je onze adviseurs. Je maakt kennis met veel aspecten van het werk binnen een Public Affairs kantoor en krijgt een uniek kijkje achter de schermen van de politieke arena. Je leert hoe organisaties hun belangen behartigen richting politiek, overheid en media. Kortom: een veelzijdige stage op het raakvlak van politiek, bestuur, media en bedrijfsleven.</p> <p><strong>Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Monitoren van nieuws en politiek:</strong>dagelijks kranten, vakbladen en opinietijdschriften scannen op relevant nieuws voor onze klanten.</li> <li><strong>Volgen van parlementaire agenda’s:</strong>bijhouden van vergaderingen en debatten in de Tweede en Eerste Kamer, relevante Kamerstukken signaleren en samenvatten.</li> <li><strong>Verslaglegging</strong>: live en achteraf rapporteren over politieke debatten en griffieverslagen verzamelen.</li> <li><strong>Research en analyse</strong>: informatie verzamelen via databanken en analyses maken voor onze adviseurs.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholdermapping</strong>: relevante politieke en ambtelijke contacten in kaart brengen en up-to-date houden.</li> <li><strong>Ondersteuning bij diverse klantprojecten</strong>: bijdragen aan presentaties, pitches en strategische adviezen.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je volgt een HBO- of universitaire opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Politicologie, Bestuurskunde, Geschiedenis, Europese Studies of Internationale Betrekkingen (en staat ingeschreven tijdens de stageperiode).</li> <li>Je hebt een grote interesse in en kennis van de Nederlandse politiek en maatschappelijke vraagstukken.</li> <li>Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en analytisch sterk.</li> <li>Je kunt complexe informatie helder analyseren en samenvatten en hebt een vlotte pen.</li> <li>Je beheerst de Nederlands en Engels taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.</li> <li>Je kunt goed omgaan met deadlines en werkt nauwkeurig, ook onder druk.</li> <li>Je bent minimaal vier dagen per week beschikbaar in de periode van 1 februari tot en met 30 juni.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij</strong></p> <p>Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals, consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om zo nu en dan eens vanuit huis te werken.</p> <p><strong>Solliciteren</strong></p> <p>Heb je interesse? Stuur dan uiterlijk 30 november je cv en motivatiebrief in via onderstaande link of naar:</p> <p>E: ----- <p>Joost Reede, T: 06 – 34 55 50 18,</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Commercial Solutions Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">As a Senior Commercial Solutions Engineer, you will work with both commercial and some enterprise prospects and customers in Belgium, aligning their goals and requirements with SentinelOne's offerings across prevention, XDR, and threat hunting. You will play an instrumental role in accelerating our sales initiatives, partnering closely with the sales team to design and propose security solutions that address the unique challenges of our customers. If you are a self-starter who thrives in a high-paced environment and is energized by pitching revolutionary technology to executives and security practitioners alike, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h3 class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">What Will You Do?</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul class="[li_&]:mb-0 [li_&]:mt-1 [li_&]:gap-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Work closely with our sales team to design and propose security solutions that meet the unique needs of commercial and enterprise technical support throughout the sales cycle.</li> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Develop and showcase a deep understanding of SentinelOne's products and solutions, aligning technical capabilities with customer needs and pain points, and deliver engaging security workshops and demonstrations to both technical and executive audiences.</li> <li title: Engineering Manager, Revenue Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and Grow Engineering Talent (Player-Coach Model):</strong> Recruit, mentor, and develop a diverse team of talented software and data engineers while leading by example risks and single points of failure across legacy and new systems.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Developer Relations, BI, Security, and Product to align on business priorities, unblock dependencies, and turn complex business challenges into reliable software solutions.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
description: Op zoek naar een werkplek waar jouw ideeën het verschil maken en waar je op niveau kan sparren met een team van ambitieuze developers? Als Software Engineer bij IXON werk je aan een modern cloudplatform dat door duizenden machinebouwers wereldwijd wordt gebruikt. Geen remote eilandjes of kortlopende projecten, maar samen bouwen aan een product waar onze klanten fan van zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Hier krijg jij energie van Binnen jouw rol als Software Engineer werk je niet aan een statische applicatie, maar aan een continu evoluerend cloudplatform met een diversiteit aan functionaliteiten. Samen met je team ben je verantwoordelijk voor het hart van de IXON Cloud: van complexe autorisatiestructuren tot een naadloze gebruikerservaring. Het doel? Onze klanten hun beheerprocessen zo efficiënt mogelijk laten uitvoeren. Om dat voor elkaar te krijgen, werk je met een moderne tech stack die onder andere bestaat uit Angular en TypeScript. Je krijgt de vrijheid om actief mee te beslissen over technische keuzes die ervoor zorgen dat onze applicaties niet alleen vandaag snel en strak draaien, maar ook op de lange termijn schaalbaar en onderhoudbaar blijven. Wat je concreet gaat doen: Je pakt de verantwoordelijkheid, en draagt zorg voor jouw kwalitatief sterke code; Je bent een sparringpartner voor je collega’s en om features technisch uit te diepen; Je tilt graag ons front-end delivery proces naar een hoger niveau, op gebied van observability, testing en deployment Je krijgt de ruimte voor PoC’s en research spikes om de nieuwste technologieën te valideren voor ons platform. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij bent een Software Engineer die gelooft dat een interface pas écht goed is wanneer de logica erachter vlekkeloos werkt. Frontend is jouw passie, maar je snapt ook wat er in de backend gebeurt. Dit maakt je een belangrijke schakel in ons multidisciplinaire Scrum team. Je werkt iteratief, leert van feedback en streeft voortdurend naar verbetering. Bovendien inspireer je jouw collega’s door best practices te delen en samen te groeien. Daarnaast zou het fijn zijn als je jezelf herkent in het volgende rijtje: Je beschikt over een WO werk en denk niveau Minimaal 5+ jaar relevante werkervaring; Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework; Je hebt sterke affiniteit met User Experience en begrijpt hoe een gebruiker door een applicatie beweegt; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels. Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Streven naar topkwaliteit en een goede werksfeer gaan bij ons hand in hand. We streven naar ontwikkeling op hoog niveau, werken met een geavanceerde tech stack en dagen elkaar inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijkertijd is de sfeer open en informeel. Vragen stellen, kritisch meedenken of een nieuw concept pitchen? Dat hoort er bij ons gewoon bij. Daarnaast krijg je alle ruimte om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Leef je uit tijdens onze vrijdagmiddagprojecten, denk mee in de Frontend Guild en verbreed je horizon tijdens onze interne tech events. Dit vullen we graag aan met: Een goed salaris passend bij jouw niveau en ervaring; Uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden: Een 13e maand, 8% vakantiegeld, Vitaliteitsbudget, WIA-hiaat verzekering en een pensioenregeling; 30 vakantiedagen om op te laden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden; Persoonlijke groei: Een uitgebreide onboarding, ruim persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget en coaching; Een gezellige werkplek inclusief een volle kalender met teamactiviteiten, uitjes en spontane borrels. Wat wij doen? Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen. Wij helpen machinebouwers wereldwijd om hun activiteiten te stroomlijnen en hun service naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Dit doen we met een pakket aan innovatieve oplossingen: van veilige remote access tot klantenportalen en geavanceerde data dashboarding. Onze oplossingen zijn ontworpen om zonder beperkingen mee te schalen en naadloos te integreren, zodat onze klanten hun services maximaal kunnen optimaliseren. Klaar om impact te maken? We houden van een laagdrempelige aanpak. Na een korte eerste kennismaking laten we je graag een live demo van ons platform zien. Zo ontdek je precies hoe en wat wij bouwen. Daarnaast maken we graag ruimte voor een kennismaking met het team, zodat je zelf kunt ervaren hoe de sfeer is en met wie je gaat samenwerken. Interesse? Klik op de Apply knop hieronder! Liever eerst informeel sparren over de functie? Neem dan gerust contact op met onze recruitment team via Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. title: Stage: Bedrijfsprocessen & Veiligheid
description: Over Nedlin Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? Stagevergoeding: € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week); Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa; Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht; Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen; Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes; Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match. Veiligheid tijdens je stage Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen. Machinekaarten worden vóór ingebruikname gevalideerd door de Technische Dienst. Wie ben jij? Je volgt een hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Integrale Veiligheidskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Engineering of Facility Management. Je hebt interesse in techniek en veiligheid en combineert graag theorie met praktijk. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s. Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage. Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen. Pak het moment Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; Washington D.C.; New York City</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.</p> <p>Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.</p> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.</li> <li>You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.</li> <li>You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.</li> <li>You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.</li> <li>You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.</li> <li>You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.</li> <li>You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet.
