title: Systems Engineer, MAPS
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>New York, NY<br>Washington, DC<br>San Francisco, CA</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s architecture is built on a homogeneous edge: every server in over 330 cities runs every service—from L4/L7 proxies (FL2, Pingora) and DNS to the Workers runtime, cache, and storage. While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL. Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability. Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team. Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on. Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work. Plus points: Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced. Dutch, German or French. An interest in cycling. Benefits 🌟 Our perks 🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!) 📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join 💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually 🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year 💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future 💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost) 🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours 💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun! 🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!) 👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family 🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts 🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions 🌈 Belonging at Laka We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com To find out more about what it’s like to work at Laka, visit our careers page here . Our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We continuously strive to build a diverse team from all backgrounds as we believe that varied experiences and perspectives makes the Laka collective even stronger. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pallet </strong></p> <p>Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy, a $12 trillion global TAM. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. </p> <p>Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, and control.</p> <p>As companies across the physical economy look to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>Remote from Switzerland</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Founding Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>This role will be remote from Switzerland. </p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent German: you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in German. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is title: Global Senior Program Manager
description: Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. Flexibility in how you organize your workweek, enabling you to balance work and personal life in a way that works for you. A strong engineering-driven knowledge culture, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation are central. Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn Sessions and Pitch Discovery Sessions, you will have ample opportunities to learn, inspire others, and develop new ideas. Who are you? With your leadership skills, business acumen and ability to bring structure to complexity, you successfully translate ambitious plans into tangible results. Furthermore, we are looking for: 7+ years of experience leading complex technical programs in a high-tech semiconductor environment, preferably within system development and with a background in mechatronics or mechanical engineering. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align multidisciplinary teams around common goals and priorities. Proven track record in delivering complex systems and development programs, from concept and design through industrialization and customer delivery. Strong technical affinity, capable of translating engineering challenges into clear plans, decisions and results. title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. The Role As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data. You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs. This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver. You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different. What Excites You Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions. Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible. Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions. Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges. Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work. Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility. Responsibilities Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges. Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements. Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios. Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions. Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made. Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation. Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations. title: Product Manager
description: Hi, I'm Maria , Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋 FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it. I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself. The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. What you'll do: Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users Write specs and acceptance criteria clear enough that the squad can move without waiting on you, then review what gets built and keep iterating Define MVPs that get something useful into teachers' hands quickly, and after launch, look at the results and decide whether to scale it, rework it or retire it Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible Help the squad see how its work lands with teachers and students, and make time to celebrate the wins What you bring: You have 3+ years of product management experience, and you've shipped B2B SaaS features that measurably changed how people use a product You spot opportunities before anyone asks for them, and you'd rather spend an extra day understanding a problem than a month building the wrong solution You can say "no" to a request and keep the relationship intact, because you back your reasoning with data and strategy You write and speak with the kind of clarity that saves everyone a follow-up meeting. Your expectations are set before the work starts, and your feedback is direct You understand how products are built technically, well enough to have a proper conversation with engineers about trade-offs. title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. What you'll do: Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases Keep performance in mind across the stack Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort What you bring: You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too What you get: Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite) 25 paid holidays per year A day off for your birthday Advantageous pension scheme 3 days of volunteering leave per year €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription Free access to our office gym Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS) Compensation: €60K – €75K • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. title: Financial Administrator
description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it. What you'll do: Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time Prepare the weekly payment run for approval Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system Support month-end close and annual accounts Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them What you bring: You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month. You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you. You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving. You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together. You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them. You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start. You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree. You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work. You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week. title: Manager Organisational Transformation
description: About the job Please note that fluency in Dutch is mandatory for this role. Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organisational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters. What will you do? Your primary focus lies in the organisational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective organisational design take a centre stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain. Your responsibilities will include: Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimisation of processes to designing and implementing new business models. Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organisational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best. Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management. Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients. Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development. Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present. Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the People & Organisational Transformation competence team, and primary Organisational Transformation. What do you bring to the table? A completed bachelor’s and master’s degree with a numerical component. At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy. At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models. The ability to translate strategic goals into implications for employees. We don’t stop at design; we support our clients through implementation. Our integrated transformation projects connect strategy, data, AI and organisational change. An interest in data, AI, change management and the human side of change is therefore essential. Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders. Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills. Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships. Fluent in Dutch and English. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritises and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the number of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organises both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly using the button on this page or get in touch with our recruitment team to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. title: Ingénieur Sécurité des Procédés - Process Safety Engineer (H/F)
description: 📜 Contexte Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse , nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles. Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés , vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie. Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site. 📌 Votre rôle En tant qu' Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés , vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés. Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance , ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire. Vos missions 🎯 Responsabilités 🔹 Analyse des risques procédés • Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA . • Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées. • Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets. 🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique • Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1 . • Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels. • Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires. 🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels • Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles. • Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés. • Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception. 🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité • Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC) . • Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables. • Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise. 🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance • Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés. • Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques . • Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés. 🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité • Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire. • Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA) , aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité. • Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés. 🔹 Formation & sensibilisation • Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés. • Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site. • Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés. Vos compétences 💼 Votre profil • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent . • Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique. • Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés. • Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX . • Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO . • Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements . • Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes. • Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques. • Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie. • Français courant et bon anglais technique , notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux. Avantages 🏆 Conditions du poste • 📍 Lieu : Genève, Suisse • 🕒 Taux d'activité : 100 % • 📅 Date de démarrage : flexible, à convenir ⚠️ Ce poste est ouvert aux candidat(e)s de nationalité suisse ou européenne (UE/AELE), ou titulaires d'un permis de travail valable pour la Suisse. title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Climate Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.</p> <p>Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.</p> <p>The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.</p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.</p> <p>You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.</p> <p>Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.</p> <p><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.</li> <li>Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.</li> <li>Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.</li> <li>Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.</li> <li>Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.</li> <li>Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.</li> <li>Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.</li> <li>Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.</li> <li>Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.</li> <li>Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.</li> <li>Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.</li> <li>Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.</li> <li>Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Should Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.</li> <li>A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.</li> <li>Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.</li> <li>Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.</li> <li>The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508 Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals Fluent English, written and spoken Preferred qualifications and personal profile Nice to have Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification Personal profile Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end Start date: Immediately Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Webservices/XML/SOAP/REST/OData eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder? Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten: Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell : Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen. Weiterbildung : Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem Zukunftsorientierung : Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft. Tools : Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen. Teamspirit : Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen. Come as you are! : Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut! Workation & Entsendungen : Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende. Work-Life-Balance : Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance. Wellbeing : Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten. Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten? Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht. Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur. Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder? Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen. Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse. Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen! Seit 2012 stehen wir als Schweizer Dienstleister für verlässliche SAP-Landschaften und fundierte Betriebserfahrung. In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den Betrieb, den Unterhalt und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Rechenzentren, Netzwerke und Firewall-Infrastrukturen. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld. title: Software Developer in Observability
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a Junior developer with a proven track record in Python and/or Go. As part of the Observability team, you will develop a cloud-native monitoring stack that composes best-in-class open-source monitoring tools. The stack is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The monitoring stack will monitor applications running on a mix of cloud technologies such as Kubernetes and OpenStack, as well as bare-metal, virtual machines and containers. The stack will be capable of monitoring applications and infrastructure irrespective of whether they are operated by Juju, and will leverage multiple data sources at various levels of the architecture, including Juju itself, to contextualize the collected telemetry and insights delivered to the end-users.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You can read more about the project 400;">Debug issues and interact with a vibrant community</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Review code produced by other engineers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Attend conferences to represent Canonical and the Charmed Observability Stack</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span you</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You love technology and working with brilliant people</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span track record in open source</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have a working knowledge of Go</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we offer colleagues</span></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">About Canonical</span></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. title: Project Manager/in Kassensysteme
description: Möchten Sie eine Schlüsselfunktion in einem aufstrebenden Unternehmen übernehmen? 4POS AG ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich der Herstellung und Vermarktung von Kassenhardware& Self Checkout Systemen. Dabei verkörpert 4POS Schweizer Qualität in Design und Entwicklung von Kassensystemen und anderen Lösungen für den Point-Of-Sale (POS). Zur Ergänzung unseres Teams suchen wir Sie. Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben: Sie sind für die selbstständige Abwicklung von Projekten zuständig und verantwortlich. Vor allem internationale Kundenprojekte, aber auch interne Projekte. Sowohl in technischer wie auch in kommerzieller Hinsicht. Zu den vielseitigen Tätigkeiten gehören die Analyse, Initialisierung, Planung, Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Nachbetreuung von Projekten, die Sicherstellung der Produktqualität sowie Mitarbeit bei Einführung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Produkten. Als Unterstützung des Verkaufs übernehmen Sie zudem vielfältige Aufgaben, koordinieren mit Herstellern, Partnern und Kunden. Zusätzlich helfen bei der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen und Messen mit und leisten stellvertretende Unterstützung im Team, insbesondere der anderen Project Manager und des CSO. Qualifikation Ihre Persönlichkeit: Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Aus-/Weiterbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement oder einer ähnlich gelagerten Tätigkeit im Bereich von Computer-Hardware, im Idealfall von POS-Lösungen für den Einzelhandel oder die Industrie. Sie können Ihre Aufgaben priorisieren und denken vernetzt. Mit Ihrem Organisationsflair verlieren Sie auch in hektischen Zeiten nie den Überblick. Sie sind es gewohnt, mit Ansprechpartnern bei Kunden auf verschiedenen Ebenen einwandfrei und sicher zu kommunizieren. Absolute Teamfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsvermögen und eine selbständige Arbeitsweise sind weitere persönliche Eigenschaften. Kenntnisse des ERP Systems Microsoft Dynamics NAV sind von Vorteil. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab. Sprachlich können Sie mündlich und schriftlich mühelos in deutsch und englisch kommunizieren. Französisch ist nicht zwingend, wird aber positiv gewertet. Benefits Ihr künftiges Umfeld: Wir bieten Ihnen eine spannende und vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld, eine auf den neusten Stand abgestützte Infrastruktur sowie branchenübliche Anstellungsbedingungen. Ein motiviertes, kollegiales und kompetentes Team mit flacher Hierarchie erwarten Sie. Anstellung in der Schweiz (office in Baar) oder in Deutschland (home office) möglich. Mit Ihrem unternehmerischen Handeln möchten Sie etwas bewegen und Ihr Engagement für 4POS soll Sie und uns weiterbringen. Möchten Sie sich dieser neuen Herausforderung stellen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen, welche Sie bitte vertraulich an Herr Lutz Nungesser einreichen. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je. Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
