title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloudflare Hyperdrive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA (Hybrid)</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.</li> <li>You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. title: Accountant
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. <li><strong>AI-Enabled Efficiency:</strong> Comfort using AI tools responsibly to optimize workflows, reduce manual work, and improve team productivity.</li> <li><strong>Technical Curiosity:</strong> similar platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Salesforce, Jira, Google Workspace, and Confluence.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>CAPM, PMP, or Agile certification is a plus, as is fluency in more than one language.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Compensation</strong> </h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">Compensation Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Rolle KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding. Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst. Deine Aufgaben Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine. Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft. Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis. Du begleitest Neukundinnen und Neukunden beim Onboarding, damit der Legal Agent schnell Teil ihres Alltags wird. Du bist an Events, Fachanlässen und Hochschulen das Gesicht von Jurata. Du pflegst deine Sales-Pipeline und unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und zuverlässig. Du bringst Kundenfeedback und Einwände strukturiert ins Team ein und gestaltest so Produkt und Playbook direkt mit. Was du mitbringst Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis. Du studierst Rechtswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master) und kannst dich mit einem Pensum von 40–80 % engagieren. Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt. Es reizt dich, juristische Fachpersonen von technologischer Innovation zu überzeugen. Du interessierst dich für Legal Tech, KI und Sales und greifst ohne Scheu zum Telefon. Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe: Du bleibst dran und lernst daraus. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig. Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch verständigen. Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus. Was wir dir bieten Legal AI an vorderster Front: Du arbeitest in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Start-ups der Schweiz, mit einem Produkt, das bereits täglich in der Praxis im Einsatz ist. Netzwerk in der Rechtsbranche: Du lernst Kanzleipartner, General Counsels und Rechtsabteilungen kennen, lange vor deinem Berufseinstieg. Bewährtes Setup: Playbooks, qualifizierte Anfragen und regelmässiges Coaching machen dich schnell selbstständig. Fixum plus Provision ohne Obergrenze: Du erhältst ein Fixum und dazu eine Erfolgsprovision, die nach oben nicht begrenzt ist. Die angegebene Vergütungsspanne umfasst Fixum und Erfolgsprovision. Flexibles Pensum: Innerhalb von 40–80 % richtet sich dein Pensum nach Vorlesungen und Prüfungen, nicht umgekehrt. Praxiserfahrung, die zählt: Du erlebst aus erster Hand, wie KI die juristische Arbeit verändert, und baust Sales-Skills auf, die dir in jeder Karriere Vorteile bringen werden. 25 Ferientage: Du hast 25 Ferientage pro Jahr, bei Teilzeit anteilig. Remote-Woche: Du arbeitest bei uns im Büro in Zürich. Nach der Probezeit hast du Anrecht auf eine Woche Remote Work pro Jahr. Fitness-Abo: Du erhältst ein kostenloses Abo für das Fitnessstudio direkt neben unserem Büro. Firmenlaptop: Du erhältst von uns einen Firmenlaptop. Teamkultur: Wir pflegen eine echte Start-up-Kultur, haben einen legendären Teamgeist und unterstützen uns jederzeit gegenseitig. Es gibt kostenlose Snacks und Getränke, regelmässige Teamevents, (freiwillige) gemeinsame Workouts und eine lockere Kleiderordnung. So bewirbst du dich Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinen universitären Leistungsausweisen, weiteren (Arbeits-)Zeugnissen und ein paar Sätzen zu deiner Motivation, die du direkt im Bewerbungsformular eingeben kannst. Ein zusätzliches Bewerbungsschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wir melden uns bei Interesse innert weniger Tage für ein unkompliziertes Kennenlernen. Passt es zeitlich gerade nicht, aber du kennst jemanden, der in Frage kommt? Empfiehl uns die Person per E-Mail an ----- Bei einer erfolgreichen Anstellung schenken wir dir als Dankeschön ein Studenten-Jahresabo für den Jurata Legal Agent. title: Manager, Commercial Outcome Architects (Customer Success)
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We are looking for a proven Outcomes Architects Manager with a strategic and entrepreneurial spirit to join the GTM Team. As the Commercial OA Leader, you will play an important role defining/iterating on our expand motions, providing customer feedback to help share our roadmap, driving increased adoption, owning ongoing value delivery, and and generating expansion revenue to grow our business. You will own the strategy and execution of your team’s segment. The Outcomes Architect team is a new function at Notion that combines RM, CSM and SE capabilities to drive workflow adoption and retention at our customers. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Increase Team Performance on Adoption, Retention, and Customer Value: Your role centers on up-leveling the team to boost product adoption, retention, customer value, and satisfaction through effective retention strategies and churn prevention in the Commercial segment (note that your team will own a subset of renewals). - Team Leadership and Development: As a leader, you'll recruit, train, and mentor a high-performing Outcomes Architect team that embodies our core values and operational goals. - Data-Driven Insights and Operational Excellence: You will build and refine a consistent KPI/OKR system that enables data-driven decisions to identify risks, trends, and opportunities. - Cross-Functional Collaboration and Partnerships: You will partner with solutions consulting and forward deployed engineers to ensure smooth customer onboarding and continuously refine the customer journey to drive long-term success. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform. - AI Workflow Adoption: You and your team will drive new workflows and build beside customers to implement them. - Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 5+ years of people management experience for a CS, sales, SE or account management team - Experience with large and strategic customers (experience with Fortune 500) - Experience working with technical stakeholders - Experience driving AI adoption - Can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely and resolve tradeoffs - Effective communicator across levels and audiences - Strong leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive-mindsets, collaboration and ability to inspire a team of direct reports - High ownership mentality - Comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of an early-stage startup - Growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of a nascent team NICE TO HAVES: - You have experience using Notion - You've built new CS playbooks or processes - Experience using Gainsight - Experienced in hiring and training talent at scale Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Project Manager
description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Main Responsibilities Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments. Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations. Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company. Requirements Your Profile Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment. Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.). Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel to client locations as required Benefits What We Offer An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions. A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer. Note We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Telco Field Engineering Director
description: <p>This is an opportunity to run the worldwide Telco Field Engineering business, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. The Telco department is composed of three regional teams (APAC, EMEA and AMER). </p> <p>We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team’s direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.</p> <p>We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.</p> <p><strong>The role of a Telco Field Engineering Director at Canonical</strong></p> <p>The Field Engineering department is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc.  The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process. </p> <p>Within the Field Engineering department, there are multiple focused teams : the Cloud/DC team, the Alliances/Partners team, the IoT team, and the Telco team. </p> <p>The telco industry is moving to software-defined services. This transformation is driven by open source software, cloud computing and the move to VNF / CNF approaches. Canonical Ubuntu is a key platform for telco innovation, and we are growing our team of specialists who work in the industry to accelerate the change.</p> <p>Canonical enables operators and communications service providers to embrace this new world, with a focus on platforms such as Ubuntu, OpenStack, and Kubernetes, and reusable, high quality automation for operations at scale.</p> <p>A Cloud Field Engineering Director is responsible for driving the strategy in presales and delivery for our telco customers. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role will be home based, managing teams in worldwide.</p> <p><strong>What your day will look like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop managers and teams of Field engineers in the areas of Presales and Professional Services</li> <li>Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor</li> <li>Work remotely in a single major time zone</li> <li>Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback</li> <li>Identify and measure team health indicators</li> <li>Implement disciplined engineering processes</li> <li>Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers </li> <li>Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices</li> <li>Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects</li> <li>Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A thorough technical understanding of the telco NFVi (VIM), NFVO, VNFM and MEC space and key telco cloud infrastructure technologies like CPU Pinning, NUMA, SR-IOV, DPDK, etc<br>Familiarity with telco architecture and industry standards<br>Working knowledge of at least one of the following domains: Mobile Packet Core (4G/5G), Private Network, Radio Access Network (RAN), Voice, IP Backbone, VAS or OSS/BSS</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Linux and networking</li> <li>Experience in technical presales</li> <li>You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English</li> <li>Passion and a track record of developing and growing people</li> <li>Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers and managers</li> <li>Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results</li> <li> An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well</li> <li> Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additional skills that you might also bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Second language - Spanish or French preferred</li> <li>Python knowledge</li> <li>Experience collaborating with external partners</li> <li>Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps</li> <li>Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including sovereign AI, and their potential applications in telco environments, such as network optimization, predictive maintenance, unified communication, and customer experience improvement</li> <li>Exposure to frameworks such as 3GPP, TM Forum ODA, eTOM, ETSI NFV, ONAP, O-RAN, or similar is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer you</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-remote </p> <p><br><br></p>

title: Director of Structured Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>New York, NY</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.</p> <p>You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.</p> <p>This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Infrastructure and asset financing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.</li> <li>Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and materials for lenders, lessors, and other financing counterparties.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare independently in negotiations with external counterparties, exercising sound judgment on risk allocation, collateral, covenants, and commercial terms.</li> <li>Evaluate lease vs. buy vs. finance trade-offs and recommend the structures that best balance cost of capital, flexibility, and risk.</li> <li>Build repeatable internal frameworks, playbooks, and processes for evaluating, approving, and executing financing transactions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Capital markets and capital structure</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and contribute analysis on capital structure, liquidity, and cost of capital.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a credible network of financing counterparties — banks, private credit funds, private equity, lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.</li> <li>Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Modeling, analysis, and decision support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain rigorous financial models supporting transaction structuring, pricing, returns, and capital allocation decisions.</li> <li>Prepare analysis and materials that distill complex financing decisions into clear recommendations for the CFO, senior leadership, and the Board.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting, Tax, and Legal on accounting treatment (e.g., lease classification), tax implications, disclosure, and documentation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Infrastructure, Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, and leadership teams to keep transaction terms aligned with network build-out plans and broader company priorities.</li> <li>Own post-close management of financing arrangements, including covenant compliance, reporting obligations, and ongoing counterparty relationships.</li> <li>Use AI-native tooling and automation to scale the function — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of experience</strong> across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — ideally including time in-house at a high-growth technology or infrastructure company.</li> <li><strong>A track record of leading complex financing transactions through to close</strong>, including direct negotiation and documentation with external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>The ability to run a financing workstream independently</strong>, without close supervision, and to represent the company credibly with senior external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>Deep structuring expertise</strong> — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills</strong>, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications</strong> of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong>, with the ability to make complex structures legible to non-specialist leadership and to influence diverse stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with ambiguity</strong> — the ability to drive clarity, manage competing priorities, and execute at a high bar in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Infrastructure) and external counterparties.</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill</strong> — fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong>, including an understanding of the discretion required at a public company.</li> <li><strong>Sector background</strong> in data centers, digital infrastructure, telecom, cloud, or AI compute preferred; existing relationships with lenders, lessors, and infrastructure investors a plus.</li> <li>MBA, CFA, or similar a plus, but not required.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $206,000 - $284,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York City based hires: Estimated annual Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes, and serving as a trusted voice to the public markets, the Board, and our shareholders. earnings and consensus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the end-to-end quarterly earnings process, helping draft and assemble the press release, supplemental financial information, prepared remarks, Q&A guidance process, including share count forecasting, sensitivity analyses, and supporting materials for leadership.</li> <li>Drive tie-out and validation work so that every figure, claim, and research, key stats and proof points, and live-call backup material.</li> <li>Coordinate the post-earnings analyst callback program, including scheduling, notes, and feedback summaries.</li> </ul> investor database.</li> <li>Help plan and run investor events, including sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and non-deal roadshows.</li> <li>Prepare briefing materials for dashboards, trackers, and validation tools that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Use AI-native tooling and automation to improve speed, accuracy, and insight across the IR function.</li> maintaining operating models, consensus models, and share count and dilution forecasts.</li> <li><strong>Solid understanding of financial statements</strong>, public-company reporting, and valuation; executives and to turn complex financial or technical concepts into simple narratives.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional attention to detail</strong>, and pride in getting every number right.</li> skill</strong>: fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong>, including awareness of materiality, fair disclosure, and Reg FD (or a strong willingness to learn).</li> <li><strong>Genuine interest</strong> in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, or AI, and in the public markets.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h3><strong>What You Might Work On</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid response:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proactive engineering:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</p> <p><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</p> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</p> <p><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</p> <p><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</p> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li> <li>Strong foundation in networking and security:</li> <ul> <li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li> <li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li> <li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li> <li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li> <li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li> <li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li> </ul> <li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li> <li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li> <li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to convey complex technical information clearly to engineers, leadership, and customers.</li> <li>Comfort owning ambiguous, cross-layer problems. Composure under pressure during high-severity incidents.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desired Skills & Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering experience with direct customer-facing accountability.</li> <li>Deep expertise at both L3/L4 (network infrastructure) and L7 (application protocols, DNS, HTTP, WebSocket).</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency with Linux command-line tools: curl, dig, git, traceroute, mtr, strace, ss.</li> <li>Data-at-scale analysis using SQL, PromQL, or equivalent.</li> <li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).</li> <li>Track record of building internal tooling or diagnostic utilities that measurably improved team efficiency.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, influencing outcomes without direct authority.</li> <li>Experience applying AI/ML to production engineering or operational workflows.</li> <li>Comfort engaging directly with enterprise customer engineering teams, including on calls during incidents.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Active Cloudflare user who understands the platform as a practitioner.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Workers, Page

awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="12,6,0">Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="13"><strong>Working Style:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="14"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="14,0,0">Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Hiring Locations: <strong>Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US</strong></h3> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: <span class="il">Bengaluru</span></strong></p> <h4><strong>About the department</strong></h4> <p>Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver.
